body:
It was 323 miles. The Cheboygan County Republicans Lincoln Day Dinner was a fantastic event at Nonna Lisa's Italian Ristorante. | | | |
---
| | | Peter:

It’s been another big week on the campaign trail as I continue to talk with everyday citizens, policy experts and elected leaders throughout the state.
---
| |
---
There are daunting issues facing us as a state and country – inflation, roads, education, and more. And now, the recent leak from the US Supreme Court has amplified the importance of the Governor’s race here in Michigan this year. As it appears the Court is about to reverse Roe v Wade, radical activists are bullying the members of the Supreme Court.
---
| **Will we see rioting in the streets again?** Let’s hope not, but the inflammatory actions of protestors and elected officials don’t bode well for the near future. _The lawlessness must stop_. It started with the leaker or leakers at the Supreme Court. It escalated when “activists” published the home addresses of the Justices online. And then **politicians like Gretchen Whitmer joined into the fray using incendiary rhetoric. She recently tweeted that she will “fight like hell."**
---
|
---
| We need to take a deep breath. The process with the Court is how our founding fathers set up our nation. Bad court decisions can be overturned upon further judicial contemplation. _**I am pro life. Period**_**.** If the Court overturns Roe v Wade, then the abortion issue will be returned to the states where the people and the people’s representatives can vote on it. That’s the way it should be. Protesters descending into the quiet neighborhoods of the Justices chanting and yelling in an effort to bully the Court is wrong. Publishing the addresses of the Justices is wrong. Leaking confidential court documents during deliberations is wrong. _We need to restore law and order, and a respect for the Institutions of Government that have served us so well for nearly 250 years._
---
|
---
| |
---
### **Skilled Trades**
This past week we celebrated National Skilled Trades Day. I like getting my hands dirty. I don’t believe any of the other candidates can say that. I recognize and celebrate the importance of skilled trades. Across the nation, many businesses require highly skilled workers in a multitude of industries – healthcare, construction, manufacturing/industry, and service categories.
---
| My education plan includes strong support for trade schools and shop classes in our public schools.
---
|
---
|
### **Cheboygan County**
It was 323 miles. The Cheboygan County Republicans Lincoln Day Dinner was a fantastic event at Nonna Lisa's Italian Ristorante. The food was amazing and I was grateful to share my message of hope and my plan to Fix Michigan.
---
|
---
---
|
---
| |
---
### **Drain Commissioners**
Drain commissioner Chris Quatrin invited me to speak to the southwest Michigan drain commissioners meeting about my campaign. We discussed the relationship between county drain commissioners and state government.
---
|
---
| |
---
### **Public Policy**
There’s more to running for Governor than just appearing at events and glad-handing. This past week I joined the The Mackinac Center for Public Policy for an evening of fellowship among friends of liberty, featuring special guest speaker Kimberley Strassel, The Wall Street Journal Columnist & Bestselling Author in Grand Rapids.
---
|
---
|
### **Endorsement**
I was honored to receive the endorsement of Berrien County Clerk Sharon Tyler. Sharon is a former State Representative who has distinguished herself as a smart and practical leader both in the Legislature and in her current role as county clerk.
---
|
---
|
---
| | [ ](https://captainmikeformichigan.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d4c9e98e87232d3682c652313&id=550644427c&e=0636b97700)
---
### **Candidates Faltering**
Several candidates are still on the brink of losing their position on the ballot.

Lots of stories in the media about this. [Check it out here](https://captainmikeformichigan.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d4c9e98e87232d3682c652313&id=89a4002102&e=0636b97700).
---
|
---
| That’s the wrap. Watch for me on the campaign trail, and be on the lookout for my new campaign commercial, “Underdog.” Coming soon.

See you out there Michigan!

Michael Brown
Republican for Governor

name: Shahid Buttar
subject: Grassroots voices exposing corruption
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Shahid Buttar for Congress Committee, 1390 Market St
body:
The first San Francisco broadcast or print outlet to cover the federal election in one month hosted a powerful intergenerational discussion this weekend. | | |
---
| | Dear Peter, **** Over the past week, millions of Americans have taken to the streets to defend the rights of women, girls, non-binary, and trans folks. Meanwhile, the powerful leader among House Democrats, Nancy Pelosi, has continued raising money for anti-choice reproductive authoritarian Rep. Henry Cuellar (D-TX). Would San Francisco make better choices if the press reported the facts, rather than actively obscuring the conservative history of incumbents from Pelosi to Feinstein by privileging their rhetoric over their records? [**Join us today to work around the failures of the press establishment and put us in a position to do their job of informing San Franciscans about history and their options going forward!**](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/wehEm_vu1NBVXOKYSqOxTCxhAMhTRXK4t_BbI_sQ5MIIEvV7NdkpWu66heNQSkVb48UV3UH-a_tms_vdqufQX3tUY3Pffk7ErU5Op0bFK-4vZHcL0XG70Ku5TO0M47PYUjMkdIDY24wGSEt_Q30czYLM_27-SOcdpewmG05PM8O25ETp29xdTBHiiHRAAZv3QHDaAYSY3vzNUZrOAxn6fLuWLJNf09YyIDl8hKzATo8YDR4Oed-V0nW5wNy1uOj1hvGyxqdRE3fRstuPMNOvhxay-Gm3wiaK3eoOqJ9UGHCDX0uL2SFnC1ZsYEg_rlY4KR6feg9Sy6535UopbRsd7P1vQi7-zcJ60MKd_SuqcOqONNhO8_ijF_3DwDlGArip/3lx/iHG_KGNHT2GW61P91POJPw/h0/pCHON3mP36S7AItaI6bOLwq6E-Tj5-foIbt0cy7UcNY) This weekend, the first broadcast outlet in San Francisco to cover our 2022 race aired a live interview that we’re excited to share with you. Mutiny Radio is a non-profit community radio collective based in a storefront in San Francisco’s Mission District. Hosts Val Ibarra and Diamond Dave Whitaker have hosted us before, and previously organized the last debate that happened in San Francisco among primary congressional candidates challenging Pelosi. That was 4 years ago. I won that debate, and then won the jungle primary in 2020. We're excited to finish the job in 2022 with your support! Diamond Dave—a poet, organizer, activist and San Francisco icon who [mentored Bob Dylan in a previous era](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/zMhPeRdLSH9QavqI0KIPYVvrp_6PcnZnijCo21jSJoDilyTMrJ_-6jPdjbO5qQMfukDMbNF-rOnC7u3QW9x4HDhaJ6mxsR4YdQ-3HqZZpwbs3qKONMOxztE_Gs0SzWZ2LDpqdvtfE0ohSZnzaPww15yWm_Syw-Y2mesgT86fwwOesnXI20repmcHQMT_nfS7bsUY7vwYOD40TFFaMXLxNvFTgwnbOsdu8K8DS62YWh7mvwKMBNoinqca5VV7OwlM00x2HHdRWXXtO0fsW5vtIogQm3fXbnsSbdaqzL5BSASWj0JhdJjqAcqCgwy7NOqQiNu0sR4CmAE4bVVE6SEFAT7ze19VhoqM-0aJ8vwFh4o/3lx/iHG_KGNHT2GW61P91POJPw/h1/ZDUAGB9dUCraGlFLVDWs1Nrd0d4o_ICe7r0_xK_sX_A)—has helped empower my community organizing since 2003. That was the very same year I organized direct action across the Bay Area responding to Bush's invasion of Iraq before volunteering for the inspiring mayoral campaign of Matt Gonzalez, the former President of the San Francisco Board of Supervisors who went on to run for the White House as a Vice Presidential candidate and continues to serve our city as the Chief Attorney for the SF Public Defender’s Office. I was thrilled to join both Matt and Dave last night at the invitation of host Val Ibarra. Activists Joan Rivard and Mona Lisa joined us, as well as poets including SF educator E.K. Keith. **Click the photo below to listen to Mutiny Radio's "Sounds from the Street" broadcast this Saturday. body:
| | | | | Press Release | May 9,, 2022
---

---
| Bailey Debate Results are IN!
---
| | |
---|---
|
This evening, Republican candidate for Congress Erik Aadland, a two-time Bronze Star--one for valor--earning combat veteran and former energy sector executive running in District 7, attended and won another CD7 Congressional debate at Platte Canyon High School in Bailey, Colorado.

Erik debated with the other candidates running for the Republican nomination in front of an in-house and online audience of over one hundred constituents.

The gallery declared Erik the winner with 59.6% of the votes. His next closest challenger came in more than thirty-eight points behind.
"Tonight's success is due to nearly 12 months on the campaign trail talking to CD7 constituents and directing my attention to what is most important to them," said Aadland. "Colorado voters want to send someone to DC who is a proven leader, fighter, and a true success story. My first-class education, hard work in the military and success in the private sector are all playing a major role in these debates, resulting in CD7 voters being confident that I am the best candidate to send to the general election, and the only one who can declare victory in November."

While my Democrat opponents are bankrolled by out-of-state mega-donors, our campaign is funded by Marylanders just like you who want to continue to make Maryland more affordable and safer for our families. But we need your help to continue getting our message out all across the state. Over the last few years, we have made incredible progress, and our state is moving in the right direction. | | | **Tanya For Arizona Campaign Round-Up**
This week Tanya took her message directly to Mesa voters at the Mesa Republican Women AZ-04 Forum. Tanya shared her thoughts on kitchen table issues that are on the minds of East Valley families like inflation, spending, and border security.

If you want Team Tanya to stop by your group next time or you are interested in volunteering, email us at info@tanyaforarizona.com

**In case you missed the forum...**

If you missed the forum and want to hear straight from Tanya on where she stands on issues and why she is running, [check out Tanya's latest op-ed](https://tanyaforarizona.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e27b684e0e86fe5dbc580daeb&id=139caf2480&e=bd2b55b0e3) in the Daily Independent. She talks about why she is fighting so hard to protect the American Dream and what she will prioritize in Congress.

Peter,

When America projects weakness & disunity, the world becomes more dangerous.

Bad actors see a green light to act, and oftentimes, they do.

We saw it last year when Afghanistan fell to the Taliban and within moments, terror and despair took over our television screens.

**Now, we are seeing a similar situation play out in Ukraine** , where as a result of naked Russian aggression, millions of people are now in need of emergency aid.

Fortunately, we are not powerless.

**Right now, my nonprofit Mercury One is working hand-in-hand with our partners on the ground to provide direct humanitarian aid and medical care** on the border of Ukraine - and I am reaching out with an urgent request for your help.

**[As we work to help as many civilians as we can, please rush as large a donation as possible to our Humanitarian Fund right now.](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/60349824:JU6Va7oN7:m:1:3253819041:8F805CCCBBD92A23D6EF1A51C6D1061E:r)**

Last year, in conjunction with our partners, Mercury One raised over $40 million to rescue over 12,500 at-risk individuals from Afghanistan including American citizens and persecuted Christians.

To have been able to play a part in a lifesaving mission of such magnitude is something I will never forget. But beyond that, it was an incredible learning experience which will help us be even more effective in the future.

**And the future is here. Right now, the mission is Ukraine. These brave people need our prayers, but they also need our direct support.**

subject: Survey on an urgent matter
body:
I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter. It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation
[View this message in your browser](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zcrevueqmatgkntk7v97ke7ir9uqp5694c11mah8_rp22sh2s8i66pb2chjm6o76cdh238h5e8he485he5o75pt7kkpq0sjnm6qb6d9le1oj8cbl6ej3fddnkgp7cc5kmdqjf972u9hffd5jekoebc5he9pm0orm6lge2cdiephb2crgetjmcpj7cjg7bd1kelhm3c5hm3jt4s3ic9j71cj6e3ib6or0e8p6cc5immpmfdr3cooj1cj6c3gbaor0s2qj2cdl66qn49fg)
This sponsored message from Pro Life Update is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zsvfttgpq0k79iccm2qh8i1nrfgd6ds9a7854uh0_rp22sh2s8i66pb2chjm6o76cdh2bs) Dear Fellow American, I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter. It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation’s future. A movement is growing, led by progressives—but supported by many well-meaning Americans—to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution. That’s why Hillsdale College is conducting a **National Survey on Presidential Selection.** By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue—views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders. You can complete the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zseqhvkjj11grkdvgks4ichl5d0hrm47bf0vvsdo_rp22sh2s8i66pb2chjm6o76cdh2bs)** For most of our nation’s history, the Electoral College, as devised by the Framers of our Constitution, was not controversial. Indeed, it was considered essential to preserving free and representative government. **But today, more than a dozen states have joined together in an attempt to undermine this constitutional bulwark of liberty.** This movement to undermine the Constitution has grown largely because of the failure of America’s schools to provide young people with a proper grounding in American civics—too many Americans simply don’t understand the importance of the Constitution, including the Electoral College, to liberty. Because of this, Hillsdale College has expanded its educational mission on behalf of liberty nationwide, directly teaching **millions** of Americans in all 50 states. These efforts, which aim to counter the Left’s domination over most of our schools, include:
* **Teaching** millions of citizens nationwide through free online courses, such as “Constitution 101” and “The Great American Story: A Land of Hope;”
* **Reaching** over 5.6 million households and businesses nationwide with _Imprimis_ , Hillsdale’s free digest of liberty;

subject: A Navy SEAL's Story:
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Van Orden for Congress
body:
I'll never apologize or back down for what I believe in--and the woke liberal Twitter mob will never silence me.

---
Peter, We've never met before - but my story is just like the story of so many Americans. My brother and I didn't have much growing up, but my mom taught us to work hard, speak plainly, and never back down from a fight. So, I joined the Navy when I was 18, **and went on to become a Navy SEAL Senior Chief and defended our amazing nation in Europe, Afghanistan, and Iraq.** Serving America was the honor of my lifetime--and I even had the privilege of showing the world our Navy SEALs when I later starred in the movie _Act of Valor._ [__](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/60353219:6iLSX7oNv:m:1:3317145305:1024EA266213613E1A2E5BCA5F688A5C:r) It was during my time in the service that I saw what poor leadership in Washington does - especially after my former SEAL teammates were killed in the attack in Benghazi. And after I retired and returned home to raise my family in Wisconsin, I decided enough was enough...and now I'm called back to public service and I'm running for Congress in the most important battleground race in the country. **Look, I 'm not shy, so I'll just say it: I'm pro-Trump, pro-Capitalism, and most importantly, pro-America.** I'm also a proud father, grandfather, and Christian. I'll **never** apologize or back down for what I believe in--and the woke liberal Twitter mob will never silence me. [**That 's why I'm personally asking you to chip in just a few bucks to help fuel our grassroots campaign and help me restore some common-sense to Washington.**](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/60353219:6iLSX7oNv:m:1:3317145305:1024EA266213613E1A2E5BCA5F688A5C:r) Pelosi, Biden, Harris, and the bigmouths in the media will do EVERYTHING they can to stop me. They don't care about us - they only care about transforming our country and having everyone think like they do. Like you, I'm not some career politician who delivers poll-tested lines. I'm not a phony elitist. **I 'm just a regular guy who loves this country more than anything** -- _and that 's why the radical left hates us the most and is hell-bent on silencing us._ But I'm a Navy SEAL and I don't back down from challenges. [**So, I 'm hoping you will join me by supporting our conservative campaign by chipping in just a few bucks right now.**](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/60353219:6iLSX7oNv:m:1:3317145305:1024EA266213613E1A2E5BCA5F688A5C:r) **[**CHIP IN $10 TODAY**](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/60353219:6iLSX7oNv:m:1:3317145305:1024EA266213613E1A2E5BCA5F688A5C:r)** **[**CHIP IN $20 TODAY**](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/60353219:6iLSX7oNv:m:1:3317145305:1024EA266213613E1A2E5BCA5F688A5C:r)** **[**CHIP IN $50 TODAY**](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/60353219:6iLSX7oNv:m:1:3317145305:1024EA266213613E1A2E5BCA5F688A5C:r)** Together, we can save the America we both love. Thank you for all that you do. For liberty, - Derrick Derrick Van Orden
Ret. Navy SEAL
Conservative Candidate - Wisconsin's Third District

URGENT Inflation Alert for Americans Over 60 |

| | | **URGENT INFLATION REPORT**
---
| **Americans Must Do THIS Now!**
---
| **LOS ANGELES, Calif.** \-- As inflation grips the U.S. many Americans are feeling the pinch.

**Prices of numerous consumer goods have exploded** in just a few weeks. Gasoline is up 56 percent. Beef is up 2.3 percent in just one month. And used car prices are up 30 percent.

**“When serious inflation hits, it hits everyone,”** says Ben Stein.

While you might be able to avoid buying a used car, it’s difficult to avoid buying _gas or electricity_ for your car.

Many Americans are now wondering, _“Just how bad is it?”_

_It’s bad. Really bad._

**Overall inflation is up 5 percent in a year** — the largest increase since 2008 — and the _fastest rate_ of increase since 1982.

If your income hasn’t increased at least 5 percent in the last 12 months, then your money just doesn’t go as far today as it did last year. In other words, **you’re going backwards**. _You’re losing purchasing power._

Wolf Richter (a noted wall street investor) argues that inflation is actually higher than reported. Worse, this lost purchasing power is _**NOT**_ coming back. Richter writes:
---
| “The actual loss of purchasing power of the consumer dollar
is **far worse** than even these very ugly inflation data [...]
And this loss of purchasing power is _permanent_.”
---
| **Unfortunately, inflation will continue for at least the next 2 years unless something unheard of happens.** Biden’s trillions in stimulus money continues to flood the economy, making inflation worse. And the Fed doesn’t plan to raise interest rates until 2023 at the earliest.

**Between now and then, inflation will continue to run HOT** — possibly even _hotter_ than right now. Which means higher prices at the pump, the grocery store, the dealership — anywhere you normally buy goods and services.

**Fortunately, Ben Stein has some suggestions to protect you** from Biden’s runaway inflation. He explains it all in his **NEW report called “Inflation, Debt & Disaster”.**

This report is 100% FREE, and you can [**download it in seconds right here**](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2zr05v9f8s956ir6fpmt1n30051vkt28hq6q25bfo_rp22sh2s8i66pb2chgeao74cph2bs).

**This no-nonsense report to protecting your wealth in retirement** will teach you how to avoid the destructive power of inflation — and possibly even benefit from it.

**Ben Stein knows what he’s talking about.** He’s lived through multiple inflationary periods and wrote extensively about them for the last 45 years. He studied economics at Columbia and Yale, and taught economics at 3 major universities and has written 5 best selling books and hundreds of articles in Barrons, Walls Street Journal, and The American Spectator about inflation.

So don’t wait, **get Ben Stein’s FREE REPORT** to protect your wealth from runaway inflation...
**= > **[**"Inflation, Debt & Disaster?" — Download Ben Stein's Free Report TODAY!**](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2zms4t0pt5fp2mksk20616c450tta895r3dpokrn8_rp22sh2s8i66pb2chgeao74cph2bs)

name: Ashley Ward
subject: Weekly Update: Approaching Primary Day
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Friends of Ashley Ward
body:
https://ashleywardforcongress.com/ [https://ashleywardforcongress.com/]
Weekly Updates
A MESSAGE FROM ASHLEY
Hi Everyone!
I’m a day late getting out our newsletter this week as we have been busy at the polls! This has been an exciting week.
We’ve received good indicators that the momentum of the campaign is growing, and we are in a good position entering Primary Day on May 17th!
It is important that we build off of this momentum!
Now is the time to remind your friends to VOTE ASHLEY WARD for Congress. Send your reminder emails, post on your social media, and help us get out the word.
Our success in this campaign will depend upon who turns out to vote, and it will likely be decided by very small margins, so every vote counts! The last Friday and Saturday of Early Voting is THIS WEEK! And Primary Day is TUESDAY.
If you have the time and are able to help out at the polling sites, we need all hands on deck. Thank you to all who have already signed up! There are 143 polling sites across the five counties. Each day that we are at the polls connecting with voters, we get votes! There are many people headed to the polls that are undecided about the Congressional race. Having someone there to pass out information about me and talk to voters can gain their vote.
Please let us know if you can help out! Sign up below:
EARLY VOTING BEGINS THIS WEEK!
We need volunteers to work polling sites during Early Voting and on Primary Day!
Having volunteers at voting sites to pass out literature to voters is a critical part of voter outreach. We are currently asking anyone who has time to consider helping us out at the polling sites across our district.
Early voting begins THURSDAY, April 28th through May 14th. Primary Day is on May 17th. Please indicate in the forms below your availability. The number of polling sites we can cover will depend upon the number of volunteers. So come on out and help, even if you only have a couple of hours!
EARLY VOTING [https://forms.gle/iRZR1M7PDAAkQdW1A] PRIMARY DAY [https://forms.gle/RJthuDNpLARSkL6s6]
Early Voting Information
[https://nvlupin.blob.core.windows.net/images/van/NGP/NGP31/1/93808/images/VotingDates.png]
Looking for where to Early Vote in your county? See the links below:
Alamance County [https://www.alamance-nc.com/elections/one-stop-early-voting-locations/]
Durham County [https://www.dcovotes.com/home/showpublisheddocument/36244/637807804159370000]
Orange County [https://www.orangecountync.gov/1116/Early-Voting]
Person County [https://www.personcountync.gov/departments-services/departments-a-h/elections/one-stop-early-voting-hours]
Note: Granville County currently has no voting sites listed on their website. Reach out to the Granville County Board of Elections to learn more.
OUT AND ABOUT
PHOTOS FROM THE POLLS
We've made it to all of the 19 Early Voting stations across the NC04 five counties!
[https://nvlupin.blob.core.windows.net/images/van/NGP/NGP31/1/93808/images/IMG_8700.jpg] [https://nvlupin.blob.core.windows.net/images/van/NGP/NGP31/1/93808/images/IMG_8787.jpg] [https://nvlupin.blob.core.windows.net/images/van/NGP/NGP31/1/93808/images/IMG_8800.jpg]
[https://nvlupin.blob.core.windows.net/images/van/NGP/NGP31/1/93808/images/IMG_8689.jpg] [https://nvlupin.blob.core.windows.net/images/van/NGP/NGP31/1/93808/images/IMG_8798.jpg]
[https://nvlupin.blob.core.windows.net/images/van/NGP/NGP31/1/93808/images/IMG_8785.jpg]
[https://nvlupin.blob.core.windows.net/images/van/NGP/NGP31/1/93808/images/IMG_8715.jpg]
SUPPORT ASHLEY'S CAMPAIGN
As early voting approaches, now is the time for the campaign to purchase outreach materials! Nearly 90% of my campaign budget goes to outreach. This means that your donation goes directly toward gaining votes. In order to reach voters in all FIVE counties of the district, we must have a robust outreach strategy.
Any donation you can give helps us reach that goal! Please consider donating today to help our campaign purchase the materials we need to reach voters!
DONATE [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/friends-of-ashley-ward-1]
https://www.facebook.com/ [https://www.facebook.com/] https://twitter.com/ [https://twitter.com/] https://instagram.com/ [https://instagram.com/] https://www.linkedin.com/ [https://www.linkedin.com/]

name: Ron Johnson
subject: I believe America is in peril. I need your support, Peter
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Ron Johnson For Senate, Inc
body:
I decided to run for the U.S. Senate in 2010 because growing entitlements and out-of-control federal spending had exploded our national debt to $14 trillion.
|
---
| | | Peter,

I decided to run for the U.S. Senate in 2010 because growing entitlements and out-of-control federal spending had exploded our national debt to $14 trillion. We were on an unsustainable path that was mortgaging our children's future.

Fortunately, Americans decided that a government controlled by liberal Democrats wasn't good for the country, and they elected Republicans to the House to halt President Obama's extreme policies. A Republican majority in the Senate followed in 2014.

As I ran for re-election in 2016, we had the prospect of electing a Republican president who could work with a Republican Congress not only to stop the expansion of liberal policies but, we hoped, to reverse some of the damage done during Mr. Obama's administration. I figured we had an opportunity to put America back on the right path, and I was more than willing to dedicate myself to that worthy effort.

By and large, Republican policies worked. Regulatory relief and a more competitive tax system helped create a healthy economy with low inflation and record low unemployment. Strengthening the military deterred our enemies, and policies designed to secure the borders dramatically reduced the flow of illegal immigration.

During the 2016 campaign, I said it would be my last campaign and final term. That was my strong preference, and my wife's--we both looked forward to a normal private life. However, neither of us anticipated the Democrats' complete takeover of government and the disastrous policies they have already inflicted on America and the world, to say nothing of those they threaten to enact in the future.

Nor did we anticipate the pandemic, the government's failed response to it, the loss of freedom that has resulted, and the tyrannical approach taken by the elites who have created and maintained a state of fear that allows them to exercise control over Americans' lives. Instead of everyone working to achieve the goal President Biden stated during his inaugural address--unifying and healing America--it feels as if our nation is being torn apart.

As I travel around Wisconsin and talk to citizens who love our country, I know I am not the only one with grave concerns. My message has always been that America is precious, and it is our solemn duty to make sure it survives and thrives for future generations.

President Reagan warned that freedom is fragile, always one generation away from extinction. As I have told crowds since my first Tea Party speeches in 2010: This is a fight for freedom. This is not someone else's fight, this is our fight, and it's a fight we absolutely must win.

I believe America is in peril. Much as I'd like to ease into a quiet retirement, I don't feel I should. Countless people have encouraged me to run, saying they rely on me to be their voice, to speak plain and obvious truths other elected leaders shirk from expressing--truths the elite in government, mainstream media, and Big Tech don't want you to hear.

In 2010 I promised I would always tell people the truth and that I would never vote with re-election in mind. When re-election isn't your primary motivation, those are easy promises to keep. Today, I am announcing I will continue to fight for freedom in the public realm by running for re-election. It is a decision I haven't made lightly. Having already experienced a growing level of vitriol and false attacks, I certainly don't expect better treatment in the future. For my campaign to succeed, I will need the support of every American who values the truth and refuses to allow lies and distortions to prevail.

Tens of millions of dollars will be spent trying to destroy and defeat me. The mainstream media and Big Tech will contribute their powerful and corrupt voices as the unofficial but reliable communication apparatus of the Democrats. We face powerful forces that desire even more power and control over our lives. Their path, paved with false hope and greater dependency, always leads to tyranny. We cannot let them win.

So I will humbly ask, Peter, for your endorsement to help me SAVE AMERICA.

Ron Johnson

subject: I need you more than ever
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Seth Moulton for Congress
body:
Team,

I want you to know just how important you are to this campaign.

When I think about my most important supporters, it’s not about how much they gave.

I think about the people who were there when I needed them most. So far, nearly 1 million people have contributed to either my first campaign or my re-election.

Now that we’re in an election year and attack ads are already running, I need you more than ever.

But here’s the thing: The NRSC just spent $1,000,000 in ONE WEEK on attack ads against me. If this is what they’re doing now, imagine what they’ll be doing in September.

And I have to be honest with you: April wasn’t our strongest fundraising month. We can’t afford to have a slow May, too. So, I want to do something special. I want to call a few of the folks who chip in TODAY. So, I’m asking:

Can you please split a $25 contribution between my re-election campaign and Seth Moulton? Help us reach our fundraising goals and defend this seat from the corporate special interest groups that want to beat us. And if you donate today, you might be one of the people I reach out to.

Donate >> secure.actblue.com/donate/moulton-kelly?refcode=20220510_MK_split

Thank you in advance for chipping in today. It means a lot.

Mark

# It's the Home Stretch!
---
|
---
| | |
# My family and I watched the Kentucky Derby together yesterday. The winner (Rich Strike) had 80 to 1 odds, the worst odds of all 20 horses. That horse had dirt caked onto its forehead and chest because he was eating the dust kicked up by his competitors.
##

##
## The favored horse (Epicenter) was leading, and had a clean shot to the finish line. You can see in this incredible moment the contrast between them as Rich Strike takes the lead.
##

##
## Sometimes in life you gotta eat a lot of other peoples dust. But when you have a fire in your belly, you push through. This beautiful animals grit and determination has given me the fuel I need for the next 7 days. We're going down the last stretch. All eyes on May 17th. I will push harder than ever before to honor my Mothers legacy.
## I Love and miss you.

name: Jared E. Moskowitz
subject: Will you join my team, friend?
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Jared Moskowitz for Congress
body:
Dear Friends,

My name is Jared Moskowitz, and I’ve spent almost two decades serving the South Florida community.

I was born and raised in Coral Springs, and my parents never let me forget that I had a duty to serve my community. When I was 25 years old — still in law school — I ran for City Commissioner in Parkland.

Ever since, I’ve dedicated my career to public service.

For six years, I served our community as a State Representative for Florida’s 97th District, fighting to improve public safety, implement climate resiliency programs, support the State of Israel, reform the justice system, protect animal welfare, and more.

And in 2018, when a gunman murdered 17 people at my alma mater — Marjory Stoneman Douglas High School — I spent countless hours with the families impacted by the tragedy. Their heartbreak was unbearable, and in the wake of unimaginable grief, my duty was to be their advocate. With their support, I fought to pass the first gun violence prevention law in decades . We saved lives, and for that effort I earned a lifetime ‘F-’ from the NRA.

When I was tapped to serve as Florida’s Director of Emergency Management, I accepted the task of keeping Floridians safe without hesitation, leading hurricane recovery efforts and implementing disaster preparation programs. And when COVID-19 hit our state in 2020, I followed the science, establishing testing sites, leading vaccine distribution efforts, and providing masks and PPE to nursing homes, hospitals, and underserved communities to help Floridians get through the pandemic.

I've served South Florida through difficult times. And now, I’m prepared to help our community recover from the pandemic and face new threats to our future as your next Congressman.
But to win this race and bring pragmatic progressive leadership to Congress, I need you to stand with me. Will you add your name to personally endorse my campaign today? [https://secure.ngpvan.com/RETAm9mcTUmGeQliUrEBQw2]

Congressman Ted Deutch has served our community as a true statesman, guiding us through the most difficult era our nation has faced in modern times.

In Congress, I’ll work to continue his legacy of strong leadership. I’ll fight to protect voting rights, expand healthcare, defend Social Security, work for real gun violence prevention measures, and advocate for the safety of the State of Israel. And I’ll fight back against the dangerous agenda of extremist Republicans like Donald Trump.

You deserve a leader who understands our community and knows that when we stand together, we can create real change. And that's exactly how I will continue my service to our community as your next Congressman. If you're with me, click here to add your name and personally endorse my campaign. [https://secure.ngpvan.com/RETAm9mcTUmGeQliUrEBQw2]

Thank you for your support. Now, let's win this race!

— Jared

subject: What the ruling on Roe v. Wade means for Pennsylvania
body:
| | Friend, We’re sure you’ve heard the devastating news by now: **The Supreme Court’s far-right majority is set to overturn _Roe v. Wade_ , allowing states across the country to outlaw abortion. ** The final decision to outlaw safe abortions has not yet been finalized, and until a decision has been made, **abortions remain legal and your rights are not infringed upon on just yet. ** **Here’s what Pennsylvania will look like for abortion access if _Roe v. Wade_ is overturned:** [](https://click.everyaction.com/k/45134145/344626712/-635965706?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNTkcvMS81NjE1OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3NzZkNjc0OS02Y2QwLWVjMTEtYjY1Ni0yODE4NzhiOGMzMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=y_4RUIKBZV_LVKM_NjwQV97k8mvUUivVQrBQDBW4OUE=&emci=e116149c-f3cf-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a&emdi=776d6749-6cd0-ec11-b656-281878b8c32f&ceid=6787172) [](https://click.everyaction.com/k/45134148/344626719/-635965706?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNTkcvMS81NjE1OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3NzZkNjc0OS02Y2QwLWVjMTEtYjY1Ni0yODE4NzhiOGMzMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=y_4RUIKBZV_LVKM_NjwQV97k8mvUUivVQrBQDBW4OUE=&emci=e116149c-f3cf-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a&emdi=776d6749-6cd0-ec11-b656-281878b8c32f&ceid=6787172) **In Pennsylvania, 13 per 1,000 women ages 15–44 had an abortion in 2019** alone,**** and although that number fluctuates over the years, not having access to safe and legal abortions will be detrimental to our loved ones and our communities. Any restrictions on abortion in Pennsylvania would have a disproportionate impact on women of color, trans men and gender non-conforming folks, and those who are low-income, as they already face obstacles accessing safe and affordable health care. Charles, from the bottom of my heart, thank you for your trust and your friendship. As Maryland’s next Governor, I look forward to partnering with you to secure a stronger future for Hurlock, for Dorchester County, and for all of Maryland.

body:

---
I am proud to support Tina Kotek for Governor. Please take a few minutes to understand why I think my friend Tina should be our next Governor.

Tina has spent her entire public service career fighting for Oregonians. She is also a very thoughtful progressive leader _and_ a climate champion.

The dangers of climate change worry me deeply and the type of world we are leaving behind for our children and grandchildren. I support Tina because she is the leader we need in office as we plan and battle against the effects of climate change in this region.

She is a proven environmental advocate, and her work as Speaker has been phenomenal battling the effects of climate change. Notably for me, in 2021, Tina fought for and worked to pass the **100% clean electricity** bill which outlines the path to get Oregon to **100% clean electricity by 2040 and includes a $50 million investment to jumpstart more community renewable projects in Oregon. There is NO doubt this appropriation will help make offshore wind happen off the southern Oregon coast within this decade. ---
Hello Peter We have big news to share with you this week: **We’re rolling out our economic agenda to provide every Marylander — no matter their zip code or background — the opportunity to succeed. ** I know we’ve faced some hard times these last few years, but it is unacceptable that in Maryland – one of the wealthiest states in the nation – too many folks are struggling to make ends meet. Marylanders deserve leadership with concrete, actionable plans to reinvigorate our state economy and support our students, families, and communities. That’s why Michelle and I have created an economic policy plan that will address all of these issues through an equity lens by... 1\. Ensuring everyone has access to the **building blocks of economic opportunity.** In order for Marylanders to reach their full potential in the economy, we need a system of supports in place that ensures workers have childcare, transportation, and accessible housing. 2\. **Building strong pathways** so that Marylanders have the skills and opportunities required for the jobs they want. The King-Siri administration will prioritize enabling a diverse, skilled, and empowered workforce and make Maryland the mid-Atlantic state where businesses and industry want to come, remain, and grow. 3\. **Supporting good jobs in healthy businesses.** With access to capital, government services that are easy-to-navigate and customer-friendly, and strong infrastructure, employers and entrepreneurs in every community will be able to sustain and create good, stable jobs that pay a living wage and provide good benefits. 4\. **Building vibrant communities statewide.** Economic activity is place-based and a King-Siri administration will ensure that all Maryland communities are positioned for success, from leveraging our federal assets like FDA and NIH to be the national leader in life sciences to ensuring thriving main streets in towns from the Eastern Shore to Mountain Maryland. 5\. **Advancing equity** and making sure our economy works for every Marylander by directly tackling systemic disparities. A King-Siri administration will work to close the racial wealth gap and ensure that policies leave no Marylander out. | | [READ THE WHOLE PLAN](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/45139595/344649862/2057365880?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDE0NyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlYzYyZjAwZS03NmQwLWVjMTEtYjY1Ni0yODE4NzhiOGMzMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=xZXCEKuOBS0kQj5L92TvuJd-qy1Gvs5YowRvUHmajbQ=&emci=f288755e-b8cf-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a&emdi=ec62f00e-76d0-ec11-b656-281878b8c32f&ceid=24635484)
---
As an educator, I understand Maryland’s ability to have a first-class workforce is held back when families can’t afford to feed and clothe their kids, when folks are threatened by eviction, or when someone falls into ill health because they can’t afford health care.
As governor, I am committed to giving all Marylanders the opportunity to thrive by making sure they have the food they need to eat, health care when they need it, safe and affordable housing, child care, and transportation to jobs. I will lead Maryland on the path to becoming first in the nation in business and industry by providing every person the chance to succeed – no matter their starting point.
**But building that future will take all of us because the success of Maryland’s economy depends on its people.** I am counting on supporters like you to stand with me and fight to give everyone, not just those at the top, the opportunity to achieve real economic dignity.
The wealth gap in our state is bigger than we ever should have let it get, and we can’t afford to wait any longer to close it. So if you believe in our plans to build a more equitable, more prosperous, and, more just Maryland, please pitch in a donation today to fuel our movement.

The King-Siri administration will prioritize enabling a diverse, skilled, and empowered workforce and make Maryland the mid-Atlantic state where businesses and industry want to come, remain, and grow. 3\. Supporting good jobs in healthy businesses. With access to capital, government services that are easy-to-navigate and customer-friendly, and strong infrastructure, employers and entrepreneurs in every community will be able to sustain and create good, stable jobs that pay a living wage and provide good benefits. 4\. Building vibrant communities statewide. Economic activity is place-based and a King-Siri administration will ensure that all Maryland communities are positioned for success, from leveraging our federal assets like FDA and NIH to be the national leader in life sciences to ensuring thriving main streets in towns from the Eastern Shore to Mountain Maryland. 5\. Advancing equity and making sure our economy works for every Marylander by directly tackling systemic disparities. A King-Siri administration will work to close the racial wealth gap and ensure that policies leave no Marylander out. | | As an educator, I understand Maryland’s ability to have a first-class workforce is held back when families can’t afford to feed and clothe their kids, when folks are threatened by eviction, or when someone falls into ill health because they can’t afford health care. As governor, I am committed to giving all Marylanders the opportunity to thrive by making sure they have the food they need to eat, health care when they need it, safe and affordable housing, child care, and transportation to jobs. I will lead Maryland on the path to becoming first in the nation in business and industry by providing every person the chance to succeed – no matter their starting point. But building that future will take all of us because the success of Maryland’s economy depends on its people. I am counting on supporters like you to stand with me and fight to give everyone, not just those at the top, the opportunity to achieve real economic dignity. The wealth gap in our state is bigger than we ever should have let it get, and we can’t afford to wait any longer to close it. name: Great America Update
subject: How should we elect the president?
body:
A movement is growing, led by progressives—but supported by many well-meaning Americans—to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution. [](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/BC.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c612934%7c6981%7c6%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz%7c1&wdmdk=mTm%2bEOeONpCngCZtpJFaiA&sysid=1)
This sponsored message from Great America Update is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c61829%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=p07SUXBnBOEjY2XQq3VkSg&sysid=1) Dear Fellow American, I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter. It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation’s future. A movement is growing, led by progressives--but supported by many well-meaning Americans--to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution. That’s why Hillsdale College is conducting a **National Survey on Presidential Selection.** By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue--views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders. You can complete the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c61820%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=Z5yQle51le0vt5KxcwC6BA&sysid=1)** For most of our nation’s history, the Electoral College, as devised by the Framers of our Constitution, was not controversial. Indeed, it was considered essential to preserving free and representative government. **But today, more than a dozen states have joined together in an attempt to undermine this constitutional bulwark of liberty.** This movement to undermine the Constitution has grown largely because of the failure of America’s schools to provide young people with a proper grounding in American civics--too many Americans simply don’t understand the importance of the Constitution, including the Electoral College, to liberty. Because of this, Hillsdale College has expanded its educational mission on behalf of liberty nationwide, directly teaching **millions** of Americans in all 50 states. These efforts, which aim to counter the Left’s domination over most of our schools, include:
* **Teaching** millions of citizens nationwide through free online courses, such as “Constitution 101” and “The Great American Story: A Land of Hope;”
* **Reaching** over 5.6 million households and businesses nationwide with _Imprimis_ , Hillsdale’s free digest of liberty;
* **Promoting** constitutional education through social media outlets popular with young people;
* **Sending** millions of pocket-size copies of America’s founding documents to citizens and K-12 schools across America, as well as to members of our armed forces; and
* **Restoring** excellence to K-12 education through Hillsdale’s Barney Charter School Initiative, which launches and provides guidance to classical K-12 charter schools nationwide.

Your answers to the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** will help Hillsdale form the most effective strategy to educate millions of Americans about the importance of the Constitution to liberty--including the importance of the Electoral College. **And this is especially important in this critical time for America’s future.** So please share your views on this urgent topic by completing our **National Survey on Presidential Selection** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. **You can take the survey using this secure link I've provided below:** **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c61820%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=Z5yQle51le0vt5KxcwC6BA&sysid=1)** And after you take your survey, I hope you will also consider supporting Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift. Since 1844, Hillsdale has been “pursuing truth and defending liberty.” Today, it does so through its extensive educational outreach efforts, while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. The support of private citizens like you is essential to our work. Please represent your state and take the **National Survey on Presidential Selection today**. Thank you for your time and attention--and for your friendship and support of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

subject: How should we elect the president?
body:
It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation’s future.
[View this message in your browser](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2znhbrrb24hevv00ak9mf68su0l21o9q9eqjjlha0_rp2ash2s8gb2sbgebjqf99jk5p7atdge5p78d5jmeqjetjjkorrbdt469r31d5jekrq9onicbqr8cjkmhpr6pbgm9i3fcliceq3ap36eap65cb5c1r3dd3h6eqnctphehoj9o5nmv970sj2cpob4pjgsipm6o3i69j31d5l6krrcob661ob4pj0s2qm6o70mkoj3d9hmlp238h1e8he4933clh68p77c1i6coh5u)
This sponsored message from Trump Train News is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zlmcs59o1qu7976etbh747gsnc500uvehqo3jeuo_rp22sh2s8i66pb2chieeo34cph2bs) Dear Fellow American, I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter. It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation’s future. A movement is growing, led by progressives—but supported by many well-meaning Americans—to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution. That’s why Hillsdale College is conducting a **National Survey on Presidential Selection.** By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue—views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders. You can complete the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zk0eckh66c9e0cfgu3ak4fngsieceqc6jna58gu0_rp22sh2s8i66pb2chieeo34cph2bs)** For most of our nation’s history, the Electoral College, as devised by the Framers of our Constitution, was not controversial. Indeed, it was considered essential to preserving free and representative government. **But today, more than a dozen states have joined together in an attempt to undermine this constitutional bulwark of liberty.** This movement to undermine the Constitution has grown largely because of the failure of America’s schools to provide young people with a proper grounding in American civics—too many Americans simply don’t understand the importance of the Constitution, including the Electoral College, to liberty. Because of this, Hillsdale College has expanded its educational mission on behalf of liberty nationwide, directly teaching **millions** of Americans in all 50 states. These efforts, which aim to counter the Left’s domination over most of our schools, include:
* **Teaching** millions of citizens nationwide through free online courses, such as “Constitution 101” and “The Great American Story: A Land of Hope;”
* **Reaching** over 5.6 million households and businesses nationwide with _Imprimis_ , Hillsdale’s free digest of liberty;
* **Promoting** constitutional education through social media outlets popular with young people;
* **Sending** millions of pocket-size copies of America’s founding documents to citizens and K-12 schools across America, as well as to members of our armed forces; and
* **Restoring** excellence to K-12 education through Hillsdale’s Barney Charter School Initiative, which launches and provides guidance to classical K-12 charter schools nationwide.

Your answers to the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** will help Hillsdale form the most effective strategy to educate millions of Americans about the importance of the Constitution to liberty—including the importance of the Electoral College. **And this is especially important in this critical time for America’s future.** So please share your views on this urgent topic by completing our **National Survey on Presidential Selection** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. **You can take the survey using this secure link I've provided below:** **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zdp6pnpj1h24qjbipga5h5hnfas1gdpc7mjhmkig_rp22sh2s8i66pb2chieeo34cph2bs)** And after you take your survey, I hope you will also consider supporting Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift. Since 1844, Hillsdale has been “pursuing truth and defending liberty.” Today, it does so through its extensive educational outreach efforts, while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding—not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. The support of private citizens like you is essential to our work. Please represent your state and take the **National Survey on Presidential Selection today**. Thank you for your time and attention—and for your friendship and support of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844
---

I wanted to do something different today. I wanted to get personal, explain who I am, and my decision to run for Congress.

**[I hope you’ll read it all the way through and, if you can, chip in a few of your hard-earned dollars to help me raise the kind of money I need to defeat a Capitol Insurrectionist >>](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/45140918/344656606/-774467154?refcode=ABD_EM_FR_2022.05.10_b1_decisionRS_X_F1_S1_C1__ac&amount=5&utm_campaign=abd_em_fr_2022.05.10_b1_decisionrs_x_f1_s1_c1__ac&utm_medium=email&utm_source=ngp&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85MzIyMyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkODRmM2RlMC03YWQwLWVjMTEtYjY1Ni0yODE4NzhiOGMzMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Yq9WpBw6bnEB5FYJp6TZwtIgaldU3Yl6Am2RVMoFWIw=)**

Let me start by saying something that some people might consider to be pretty radical.

**Rural America is just as important as anywhere else.** I grew up on the farm and it taught me the values I carry with me to this day.

Life on the farm isn’t fancy. But you sure learn a thing or two. You learn humility. Slipping and falling in manure has a way of keeping you grounded.

And when problems come, as they always do, you don’t complain, you get to work. Because talking doesn’t help the crops to grow, get the produce to market or fix that hole in your fence before the cows get out.

That’s why I am so proud of my time working with Governor Evers leading the Wisconsin Department of Agriculture, Trade and Consumer Protection. I fought to get relief for family farmers struggling to make ends meet every single day. When politicians in Madison told me to pipe down, I stood up. When they told me to be quiet, I spoke up louder. **And when they refused to confirm me in the hopes that I might just leave them alone, I got back in the fight.**

I ran for the State Senate. And I won. Now I’m there every day holding them accountable to the people of Wisconsin.

**But my opponent, Derrick Van Orden? He doesn’t understand any of this in the slightest.**

He’s basically got one approach: pit neighbor against neighbor and hope that in all the anger that generates, voters won’t notice that he doesn’t share our values at all. He was on the Capitol grounds on January 6th. That shameful, deadly day. He’s tried to cover it up because he knows people out here think that was wrong. He attacks people. Like teenage librarians. He’s a bully who can only win if we’re as divided as we’ve ever been. And if that doesn’t sound like it will be much help to you, you’re right. Derrick Van Orden is only in this for himself and to do what he’s told by his Washington backers.

But winning this campaign won’t be easy.

**[To defeat Van Orden, we need to build the most sophisticated campaign Wisconsin has ever seen. We need to register new voters, have authentic one-on-one conversations with voters to tell my story, run sophisticated digital advertisements, radio ads, television ads, and more to persuade everyone to join our campaign. But this effort will be expensive. I’m funding this campaign the right way: from small donations given by people reading emails like this one. So even though I hate to ask for money -- I have a humble request:](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/45140919/344656607/-774467154?refcode=ABD_EM_FR_2022.05.10_b1_decisionRS_X_F1_S1_C1__ac&amount=5&utm_campaign=abd_em_fr_2022.05.10_b1_decisionrs_x_f1_s1_c1__ac&utm_medium=email&utm_source=ngp&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85MzIyMyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkODRmM2RlMC03YWQwLWVjMTEtYjY1Ni0yODE4NzhiOGMzMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Yq9WpBw6bnEB5FYJp6TZwtIgaldU3Yl6Am2RVMoFWIw=)**

If you believe in me, if you believe we need to keep fighting, even when it’s hard, if you haven’t given up on the rural places many have forgotten -- join me on this journey. | For immediate release May 10th, 2022 Turning Point Action endorses Jake Evans Leading voice of young conservatives backs next generation America First leader
---
|
---
| Turning Point Action - the most organized, active and powerful conservative grassroots network on the nation's high school and college campuses - has endorsed Jake Evans for Georgia's 6th Congressional District race, calling him a new generation leader ready to fight for personal liberty and save capitalism. The endorsement comes days after Jake received the "Complete and Total" endorsement from President Trump and further proves the nation's most trusted conservative organizations are consolidating behind Jake's candidacy in the final weeks of the primary. "Jake Evans has been on the forefront of the battle for secure and integrity-driven elections," Turning Point said in its statement. "He will be a no-nonsense Congressman and will defend our constitutional freedoms at all costs. He is the future of Georgia!" Just as Turning Point Action leads to get young Americans involved in conservative causes, Jake believes it's time for the next generation to step up to lead in public office.

subject: Molding our Future
body:
| | | My friend, If you caught my speech last Tuesday, you heard me talk about my two biggest heroes: My father and President Ronald Reagan. My father was a congressman back in 1974 and he was the only Republican in Congress to vote for the impeachment of President Nixon. _**My father was never afraid to stand alone while doing what he thought was right.**_ No toxic politics. No games. _**President Reagan understood the importance of bucking partisan politics and working together for the greater good.**_ He built a big tent party and understood the importance of building our country by using addition and multiplication, not subtraction and division. **Both men were willing to do what was right, not just what the extremes of the party demanded of them.** _**An America United**_ stands for honest leadership and integrity. If we are to heal and rebuild our country into something stronger, we must have leaders who guide with integrity. [_**Stand with _AAU_ and those who lead our country with integrity. clean_body: | | | My friend, If you caught my speech last Tuesday, you heard me talk about my two biggest heroes: My father and President Ronald Reagan. My father was a congressman back in 1974 and he was the only Republican in Congress to vote for the impeachment of President Nixon. My father was never afraid to stand alone while doing what he thought was right. No toxic politics. No games. President Reagan understood the importance of bucking partisan politics and working together for the greater good. He built a big tent party and understood the importance of building our country by using addition and multiplication, not subtraction and division. Both men were willing to do what was right, not just what the extremes of the party demanded of them. An America United stands for honest leadership and integrity. If we are to heal and rebuild our country into something stronger, we must have leaders who guide with integrity. | | Let's leave the days of party-pleasing politics behind us. Thank you,Governor Larry Hogan | | | Join An America United on social media! | | ---|--- Contributions to An America United are not deductible as charitable contributions for federal income tax purposes. | | |

Fighting for you,
Brett

Friends -
Last week I visited our San Francisco Gun Violence Memorial honoring the 3,449 Californians killed by gun violence in 2020.
Every time I see these memorials, my heart is heavy. There are too many flowers, too many gun deaths, too many shootings.
California has some of the strongest gun laws in the country, but they’re undermined by states with weak gun laws.
That is why we need federal action.
I have not lost hope. I am optimistic that it will happen. And I will keep moving forward to continue our shared fight to end gun violence until every community is safer.

Earlier today the World Meteorological Association reported that Earth's average temperature has a 50/50 chance of surpassing the climate milestone of 1.5 degrees Celsius over pre-industrial levels by 2025. And this is just the latest of a long list of sobering warnings about the impact of climate inaction.
Last month the Office of Management and Budget released a cost assessment that floods, drought, wildfires, and hurricanes made worse by climate change would cost the U.S. federal budget about $2 Trillion a year — a 7.1% loss in annual revenue — by the end of this century. And we can see the writing on the wall all around us.
So, what are we waiting for? There are only two choices: be part of the solution or part of the problem.
[**Click here to make a pledge today to support Climate Action when you vote this November!**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/45151958/344683511/-1816897697?refcode=em220510ccpetition&refcode2=72278ef6-8cd0-ec11-b656-281878b8c32f&contactdata=EQE1TFn9792%2FBM5iv3o0akNsauNqatXdNZIOjiZR9gZgPuuJ17kDB76nxVsM7hDm&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84ODIzMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3MjI3OGVmNi04Y2QwLWVjMTEtYjY1Ni0yODE4NzhiOGMzMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=yo-xU3HVD70ISSu8fNkWJS5huVbNY6W4vh_KnTe9JIM=&emci=4a5cf6f2-7ed0-ec11-b656-281878b8c32f&emdi=72278ef6-8cd0-ec11-b656-281878b8c32f&ceid=2216363)
**[Make the Pledge](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/45151959/344683512/-1816897697?refcode=em220510ccpetition&refcode2=72278ef6-8cd0-ec11-b656-281878b8c32f&contactdata=EQE1TFn9792%2FBM5iv3o0akNsauNqatXdNZIOjiZR9gZgPuuJ17kDB76nxVsM7hDm&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84ODIzMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3MjI3OGVmNi04Y2QwLWVjMTEtYjY1Ni0yODE4NzhiOGMzMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=yo-xU3HVD70ISSu8fNkWJS5huVbNY6W4vh_KnTe9JIM=&emci=4a5cf6f2-7ed0-ec11-b656-281878b8c32f&emdi=72278ef6-8cd0-ec11-b656-281878b8c32f&ceid=2216363)**
There are a number of strong proposals for action, like my Polluters Pay legislation that just needs two more votes in the Senate to become law. It would generate about $500 billion over ten years from the largest climate polluters — like big oil companies ExxonMobil, Shell and Chevron — to help clean up the mess they've made. clean_body: We need bold action now. = Earlier today the World Meteorological Association reported that Earth's average temperature has a 50/50 chance of surpassing the climate milestone of 1.5 degrees Celsius over pre-industrial levels by 2025. And this is just the latest of a long list of sobering warnings about the impact of climate inaction. Last month the Office of Management and Budget released a cost assessment that floods, drought, wildfires, and hurricanes made worse by climate change would cost the U.S. federal budget about $2 Trillion a year — a 7.1% loss in annual revenue — by the end of this century. And we can see the writing on the wall all around us. So, what are we waiting for? There are only two choices: be part of the solution or part of the problem. There are a number of strong proposals for action, like my Polluters Pay legislation that just needs two more votes in the Senate to become law. It would generate about $500 billion over ten years from the largest climate polluters — like big oil companies ExxonMobil, Shell and Chevron — to help clean up the mess they've made. They would pay about $5 billion a year; roughly less than 3% of their gross receipts. And we need to accelerate our move away from dependence on oil — which will also make it harder for countries like Russia, Saudi Arabia, and other big producers to use their ability to raise global oil prices to pressure us and others. We owe it to the next generation to take action now. Thank you for being part of the solution. name: Derrick Van Orden, conservative Ret. Navy SEAL
subject: A Navy SEALs Story:
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Van Orden for Congress
body:
I'll never apologize or back down for what I believe in--and the woke liberal Twitter mob will never silence me.

---
Patriot, We've never met before - but my story is just like the story of so many Americans. My brother and I didn't have much growing up, but my mom taught us to work hard, speak plainly, and never back down from a fight. So, I joined the Navy when I was 18, **and went on to become a Navy SEAL Senior Chief and defended our amazing nation in Europe, Afghanistan, and Iraq.** Serving America was the honor of my lifetime--and I even had the privilege of showing the world our Navy SEALs when I later starred in the movie _Act of Valor._ [__](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/60356882:JdRy6coVN:m:1:3299561967:DE0BA7A9CC222469E798062D35AFBF27:r) It was during my time in the service that I saw what poor leadership in Washington does - especially after my former SEAL teammates were killed in the attack in Benghazi. | | | Dear Peter, Like many, I am still processing the breadth of the coordinated effort that went into the ballot-harvesting scheme exposed in the recent documentary [2000 Mules](https://bendaforcongress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ace2cfdb811af9316dec053d7&id=3163a6ffa7&e=58a207e9d5). The concept that government officials are the only ones qualified to establish, administer, report, and self-audit our elections is not acceptable. As citizens, we need to engage in this critical process and demand transparency.
---
|
---
| [HELP MATT KEEP ELECTIONS SECURE](https://bendaforcongress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ace2cfdb811af9316dec053d7&id=0bf0148b05&e=58a207e9d5 "HELP MATT KEEP ELECTIONS SECURE")
---
| In the short two months that I have been a candidate for Congress, I have done just that – demanded transparency through an initial set of public data requests to county election officials to test their systems for vulnerabilities.

This is in direct contrast to my opponents who for years have been part of the legislative and bureaucratic process that should have been used to build accountability in our election system. On their watch, the election system has been infiltrated by these influences and now we are seeing the results of their complacency.

For years, Democrats have focused on tilting the election process in their favor in a coordinated effort to win elections at all costs. _With your vote in the May 24 Special Primary Election_ , we will create a grassroots team to push back and make southern Minnesota a bastion for secure, fair, and transparent elections.

Sincerely,

body:
"Conservative Momma" says...
| | | | | Endorsement | April 22, 2022
---
|
---
| "Conservative Momma" Endorsement
---
| | |
---|---
|
Here is the latest from the Aadland for Congress newsroom:

(May 10, 2022) Today, Erik Aadland, Congressional District 7 (CD7) Republican candidate for Congress, announces a formal endorsement from Rachel Keane, better known as "Conservative Momma".

Rachel, "Conservative Momma," is a vlogger, blogger, speaker, commentator, and political strategist who actively engages other individuals online through social media. With hundreds of thousands of followers, Rachel is a well-known conservative voice, particularly to mothers who want to get involved in the conservative movement.

Rachel has served as Assistant District Captain, Precinct Leader, and Bonus Member to Colorado's Republican Central Committee. Rachel has also contributed to numerous political campaigns, holding the positions of spokesperson, strategist, Communications Director, and Chief Director of Messaging. In 2016, Rachel was the CO-Chair for the Millennial/Women's vote for Donald Trump's Presidential Campaign.

In a statement sent to Erik Aadland's campaign, Conservative Momma said:

"Our country is in a battle against a socialist agenda wanting to destroy everything we hold dear, which is why we need people in D.C. who will fight for this country like never before. Erik Aadland is the exact fighter we need. Moms' want someone they can trust to go to the Capitol and stand up for family values and conservative beliefs. Erik is a successful businessman with global experience, a battle-tested war hero, a true conservative and, most importantly, a man of faith and father of three. I wholeheartedly support Erik in his run for Congress and know Erik is the only candidate who can take on, and defeat, far leftist, radical Brittney Petterson."
|
---
|
### Erik's remarks
---
| "I entered this race to create a brighter future of my children, which is why Rachel's (Conservative Momma) endorsement is so important to me. For years, Rachel has been actively fighting for conservative values because she, too, wants a more hopeful tomorrow for her children. She fearlessly speaks out against the radical Left's obvious drive to indoctrinate our children and has been on the frontlines pushing back against Progressive Marxist propaganda. I am incredibly grateful to be supported by such a strong and outspoken conservative woman who is truly making a difference in the political arena."

| About Erik Aadland
---
Jefferson County resident Erik Aadland is a West Point graduate and a twice-decorated Bronze Star veteran--one for valor--from his time in Iraq and Afghanistan. Concluding his army career in 2011 as a Captain, he pursued a career in the oil and natural gas industry with his work culminating as a project manager directing the onshore construction of the Leviathan Project in Dor, Israel. This project resulted in Israel being a net exporter of natural gas. Erik holds a master's degree in the field of psychology. He is a devoted husband and proud father of three children.

Volunteers and professionals began joining the cause to help send Erik to Washington in June of 2021. Staff personnel now cross the spectrum of political pundits, professional people and neighbors.

Peter,

Last week I sent this email out asking for your personal endorsement ahead of my primary - **next Tuesday.** So far, the response has left me a bit disheartened; only 226 people have offered their personal endorsement. I'm resending the original email to see if I can encourage a few more of you to signal your support for me today.

As you know, I challenged a career politician in 2020 who has been in D.C. since 1986. I narrowly lost that race – **by just about 5 points** – after Nancy Pelosi spent more than $5 million on defense.

Now, Peter DeFazio is calling it quits and has endorsed the Oregon Labor Commissioner to replace him in D.C.

Over the last several months we’ve seen a groundswell of support from every corner of the country. From Republican leaders in Washington, D.C., to folks in Oregon’s 4th district, t**o the more than 9,000 conservatives who have made a contribution to help me flip this seat Republican** for the first time since 1975.

The Republican primary on May 17th is fast approaching, and it’s the goal of my campaign to build as much momentum as we can before then. I'm hoping to get 1,000 conservatives to personally endorse my campaign before May 17th (Primary Day). **Would you do me the honor of signaling your endorsement of my candidacy today?**

[](http://links.alekskarlatosforcongress.com/u/click?_t=7e7d86e0b42141418fdbf0bb715c41e9&_m=7f103af7bc704a70a8e0201fc9511b4c&_e=BaxVSIS2bk4Ahwz8IoWA0BXQtWR3dwJdqaYS1G_8_TcC-C40KTAuedTFAphug6NeF-tcBaUlbp3X_pHqITv_th9Z845ZolINqddmr5ivHkW6FA4FoSgw6zpNnt2Q2HewuJ0Xnr9DaKBv9J2JVUfoS38XTbkn7G7oBZascml0HymyeAuq_xuDUic4ZZ0Sb9x31AkSo2hld3BGSlmxUJlB4qFVhYRFy3ePb3eXINrD0a_xKiiWJWAX9Jw8zGvyBYcKS_muDlW06mvlYrn7w80IO5Nnsmy0rtLUKbnpApJBdYWyVSalDzC9iGkdhZGG2_UeX5Jt29OeD9IsRMnjGLmSbzux_UthU4ln5RR52vzOVQR0RbipeflBfOpcGDLvi4bKIbrrIke0BIEJbDM6rfHzB-vmmoytQsOxj1rkkWKhOQJXSzU3ZIPU8M6fWBE7Ng1CCKdp0Ri-SYjq0Bb938mX_OWNa2O9t-VOSYWpRePE1wlTaCufCCspAVVHbUTwN1yiJ0vvbTSkErT4-OZAF6IUtSnU8g5I3sN9dswOak3WQ73ifpqVYpoXuPt_wUBHRpNQoPWdqicftAk1j8qWsuHoww%3D%3D)

Beating my new opponent in this open race is not going to be easy, especially since she’s going to try and paint me as an out of touch radical right Republican. **She has the backing of not only the Democrat incumbent, but the entire Democrat establishment.**

Not from Oregon? Let me tell you why you should pay attention to this race.
* Donald Trump only narrowly lost my district – **by LESS THAN 1/10 percent in 2016**

* If we flip this seat, it’s a good sign that Republicans will take back the House.

* With Democrats polling numbers sluggish, this could be the year to flip a district red that is only marginally more Democrat than the nation as a whole.

[](http://links.alekskarlatosforcongress.com/u/click?_t=7e7d86e0b42141418fdbf0bb715c41e9&_m=7f103af7bc704a70a8e0201fc9511b4c&_e=BaxVSIS2bk4Ahwz8IoWA0BXQtWR3dwJdqaYS1G_8_TcC-C40KTAuedTFAphug6NeF-tcBaUlbp3X_pHqITv_th9Z845ZolINqddmr5ivHkW6FA4FoSgw6zpNnt2Q2HewuJ0Xnr9DaKBv9J2JVUfoS38XTbkn7G7oBZascml0HymyeAuq_xuDUic4ZZ0Sb9x31AkSo2hld3BGSlmxUJlB4qFVhYRFy3ePb3eXINrD0a_xKiiWJWAX9Jw8zGvyBYcKS_muDlW06mvlYrn7w80IO5Nnsmy0rtLUKbnpApJBdYWyVSalDzC9iGkdhZGG2_UeX5Jt29OeD9IsRMnjGLmSbzux_UthU4ln5RR52vzOVQR0RbipeflBfOpcGDLvi4bKpletCwM57r1xYD0KwYWaz4OPk2FYaruqK2CgwB6QDVz0LspSEVPHOOsPSn3d1a6g_2jt1rKZBzzyqKQ7kvqA_nQ0Aq0Q8nRoj5wXf7H-EU6qPtRF_4FXhw-mxXN-p0TaiPPPfchfbuQk70DFkgaQqhe589-j-te7zEQb60368c_8zPP-rZuAWNPKYyXEQn03PbxaviXgok2Bo0oAUeW_UQ%3D%3D)

I appreciate your support - no matter where you live. We will all benefit from tossing Nancy Pelosi and her cronies to the curb.

body:
Gas prices have risen dramatically since the Biden administration took office [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/BC.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c210334%7c9053%7c8%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz%7c805&wdmdk=grhJenf9o%2bVQdFOPQWGmEg&sysid=1)

---
Dear Fellow Conservative, Gas prices have risen dramatically since the Biden administration took office, and I’m sure you’ve felt the pinch at the pump just like the rest of your fellow Americans. There’s no doubt in my mind that our nation’s citizens are in need of relief. But instead, President Biden has throttled U.S. energy production. And he has trapped much of our nation’s vast energy reserves behind a wall of bureaucratic red tape. That’s why I’m sending you this email today. I’d like to hear how the Biden administration’s energy policies have affected you and your family. [**Would you be willing to share your thoughts in this brief 8 question survey?**](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c21881%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=RQaKI0Pd%2bmJIG0cJe%2fKGIw&sysid=1) By doing so, you will help The Heritage Foundation understand what people like you think--and use your answers to fight back against the Biden administration’s radical anti-energy agenda. The survey should only take a few minutes of your time, but your opinion is incredibly valuable. **You can get started right now using this secure link:[https://secured.heritage.org/energy-independence-survey/](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c21882%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=QQM%2bVbcFYJ7QZYo31shFOA&sysid=1)** Thank you so much for your time. I am truly grateful. Best, Andrew P. McIndoe

subject: Today I spoke with a County Committee Member....
body:
. who silently supported us early on at the Hunterdon County Convention.
Since then I have met many CC folks who supported Team Isemann (over 100
Committee votes!), some vocally and many in silence, afraid to speak out. I
understand why.

As a CC Member and later as John's Campaign Manager, I experienced the
Conventions firsthand in multiple counties. I have learned more about the
process than I would like to know, attended far too many bad dinners where
local politicians fawn over one another, and watched our opponents waste
hundreds of thousands of dollars on uninspired campaign mailers and
robocalls. This further solidifies that the Problem with Politics is
Politics.

Many of you know that John and I have worked tirelessly because we have a
unique and vital opportunity to seize. An opportunity to take back Congress
and give this district a representative that will truly represent us in
Washington. We have put our careers on hold, spent our personal savings, and
spent countless long days in my garage and on your doorsteps to create
change for our state and future constituents. Working with John these past
seven months has only reinforced my belief that he is our best choice for
Congress. He is a model of servant leadership, integrity, and humility.

Back to that Silent Committee Member - today she very kindly wrote a check
for Team Isemann. These acts of support continue to encourage us as we
move into the final 28 days before Primary.

I wanted to share these new videos <https://youtu.be/Ep7CzhBDsWY> that cost
the campaign nothing other than our hard work and Team dedication:

<https://youtu.be/Ep7CzhBDsWY>

I am reaching out to you now because we need your financial support. We
have 28 days until the Primary. Money donated today will be used to promote
these and other new videos on Social Media.

all you have done and continue to do. We appreciate it.

Amy Wiehl
