subject: Deadline Today! Register for GOP State Convention
body:
| Peter -- Congratulations and thank you to all who took the time to become delegates and alternates for this endorsement process. You are about to take part in a historic opportunity to **Turn Minnesota Red!** The votes you cast this weekend will be among the most important votes you ever make, so we need everyone engaged and participating. This race will be very close and every vote will count! **Join us at our hospitality suite!**
* Talk about the issues and the candidates over **WINGS with a cash bar!**
* Test your marksmanship at our **Shooting Range!!**
* **Play Political Bingo!!** \- Turn in a bingo card and match the quotes to a candidate for a _free drink!_
* Get your free **Dr. Neil Shah for Governor Shirt!**

**Do not forget to register at a discount by 5:00pm today!** **Alternates** \- we need your help! Join our volunteer team and help out in our hospitality suite. Many alternates will get seated as delegates! If you haven’t received a registration email, or need assistance with registration, please contact the party at mj@mngop.com or 651-222-0022. **We Want Paper Ballots.** Election integrity begins at home, and we conservative Minnesotans understand the necessity of having a transparent and auditable endorsement. Our campaign stands out because we consistently put **Principles over Politics Every Time**. Minnesota has relied on paper ballots to endorse candidates for the vast majority of its history. As we push to **Remove Dominion Voting Machines from Minnesota** , we need to remain consistent, principled, and fair. The e-voting proposed for the state convention is not through Dominion, but it does lack any form of transparency or auditable trail. Some e-voting systems allow for observers and audits. This one does not. We need auditable and transparent paper balloting to ensure we have a clean endorsement that all candidates can abide by. We need to unify and beat Walz \- not run to a primary. **We need an endorsement, and I will abide by it! Let’s endorse with paper, as we have for a very long time.** I hope you stand with me in adhering to our conservative principles. **Watch last night’s debate** if you missed it! It starts 1 hour and 40 minutes into [this live stream.](https://electneil.nationbuilder.com/r?u=GQ96LxW7tJscudkL8mlwNzVEKXk7dMDJzwJlfbbiiRZSk5DWp0YMVKQZ2uWtMTqK&e=d39b8e369eb2bbdd6f36e913aaadeb34&utm_source=electneil&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=state_convention&n=1) Let’s rally together and secure this historic victory for Republicans in Minnesota and Grassroots Conservatives nationwide! Thank you! Dr. Neil Shah Conservative Candidate for Governor [Electneil.com](https://electneil.nationbuilder.com/r?u=iUaD1gacZHU3dYzSqkV0rOkbRklTyTNtmBTRPmVdijk&e=d39b8e369eb2bbdd6f36e913aaadeb34&utm_source=electneil&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=state_convention&n=2)[](http://electneil.nationbuilder.com/?e=d39b8e369eb2bbdd6f36e913aaadeb34&utm_source=electneil&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=state_convention&n=3)

Today is the day you get to cast your vote for who you would like to see run as the primary Republican candidate. The day we have greatly anticipated is finally here! Our time to take back our state begins today.

Today is the day to vote and every single vote counts!

I cannot express how grateful I am for all of you who have supported my candidacy these past sixteen months. From Facebook shares to monetary donations, door-to-door canvassing to setting up meet and greets, my chances of winning would not be even close to what they are today without all of your sacrifice and hard work. And please believe, this race is still unspoken for and I have every chance of winning today.

I ask you to please continue the vigilance and hard work for one more day. As many Nebraskans are still undecided as to who to vote for, please continue to flood social media with your support. Our radio and Facebook ads will continue to run all day long. Ultimately, I ask for your prayers over the polls today. Prayers that the election will be legitimate and that God's candidate of choice will succeed. As we have found out in the recent years, down-ballot and local candidates matter a lot. I encourage you to research your options and know who you are voting for. Below is a link to a list of endorsed candidates by the Nebraskans Against Government Overreach. You can also find their candidate assessments on their website so you know why they endorsed the candidates that they did.

Recommended candidate list: [https://nago.group/candidateassessment/](https://shoutout.wix.com/so/76O2kOaQB/c?w=LIGhEmDW1IupNR2AlkHIufwK_Kl-xN5_TYoMoTUixrA.eyJ1IjoiaHR0cHM6Ly9uYWdvLmdyb3VwL2NhbmRpZGF0ZWFzc2Vzc21lbnQvIiwiciI6ImIyNzZmNmU2LTNkNDQtNDg0MS05YzYyLTZiZGE4OTY4NmE1MyIsIm0iOiJtYWlsIiwiYyI6IjdmNDE2ZDFjLTU3ZDUtNDBkYi1hNTNjLWYyYmMyODgzOTFkMCJ9) Lastly, I just want to encourage you to not live in fear of who may be elected. I fully understand that we have some candidates who could be disastrous for our state. Vote your conscious and leave the rest in God's hands.

To God be the glory for this day. If the candidate you want to win doesn't, remember that He is still in control.

"All that it takes for evil to succeed, is for good people to do nothing." - Edmund Burke
With sincerest gratitude and humble appreciation, I wish you all Happy Primary Day!

Breland Ridenour
---
| | |
---
| | What's Next?
---
| | If I do not win:

I have put many things on hold over the past 16 months of campaigning. My family, my home, and other areas of my life have taken a backseat to this campaign. I will be making up for those sacrifices.

I'll finally have some time and energy to write some more guitar rifts, fix my car (after putting 35k+ miles on it in the last year), and work on eating healthy again.

If I do win:

I will take a few days to recoup, then will initiate the plans to expand our campaign operations and prepare for November's election! The guitar rifts will have to wait... :)

---

| | "Let each citizen remember at the moment he is offering his vote...that he is executing one of the most solemn trusts in human society for which he is accountable to God and his country."\- Samuel Adams

| | From the Desk of Dr. Ben Carson: Hello, I feel like our culture has forgotten—or ignored—some very important and basic lessons when it comes to the development of human life. Our society has been infected by an anti-life ideology, treating its most vulnerable members as disposable objects. Abortion that was once thought of as a last resort in a medical emergency has become the new normal. Medicine tells us that life begins at the moment of conception. It also tells us when an unborn baby develops a heartbeat, brainwaves, and nervous system. Yet, despite all of this, the unborn are not treated as though they are alive or even human. **As a surgeon, I have operated on infants pre-birth. I can assure you that they are very much alive.** [](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2z4hhtlf02g105jia9om0godikougi3ht2mg0q930_rp22sh2s8i66pb2c9i64p34clh2bs)
_Dr. Ben Carson, Founder and Chairman of American Cornerstone Institute_ Life is a precious gift that has been given to us from our creator. No person is disposable, and every life is precious according to Him. I believe that everyone deserves life, even those who have been denied this right by our society. I believe that together we can make a difference and bring dignity and a voice to the unborn. I also believe that I’m not alone in this belief. I believe that you believe that too. I’ve started working with a group of like-minded individuals who are looking to change our culture. We want to build a society that values life but that takes people like you and I making a commitment. The first step is clearly stating what we believe and what we are willing to do to protect the lives of the unborn. [**Will you join me today and stand up for those who cannot do it for themselves?**](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zrl0vdn2vgqt3e5k541ngqigbj4bsq202tvi4gp0_rp22sh2s8i66pb2c9i64p34clh2bs) I’ve created a new pro-life pledge; I’d love your support. Would you read the pledge below to see if you align with our shared goals and are willing to commit to fighting for the lives of the unborn? [https://offers.americancornerstone.org/pro-life-statement/](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2z4b59mm8jtbc3tt3jjqivl6p6ekjae3oh9h4iouo_rp22sh2s8i66pb2c9i64p34clh2bs) Regards,
Dr. Ben Carson
Founder & Chairman
American Cornerstone Institute

When I left teaching to run for office, despite the odds stacked against me, the community rallied behind me. Thousands of grassroots supporters like YOU stepped up and made a difference. **Together, we pulled off the impossible. Together, we will bring it home again. **
With all of you behind me, I know there is nothing we can’t achieve. But I won’t take anything for granted. These positions are not anointed or appointed – and we will work for every vote, just like we did four years ago.

With McConnell only one seat away from Senate control, this race could decide our majority. That’s why we’ve set a goal of raising $25,000 by midnight to keep on track with the GOP’s millions,but right now we’re falling behind. [](https://act.myngp.com/el/VGdvqt0VlZIcH0NSS7nAeds-9Q69JjO726QyXe0Hw5s=/imw5xtIwyCZUey0Pv71O3EyQ8KEH6MNkutRfhMdi-ZA=?ms=em22_220510_savmil_adv_gq_act___DK_ettx&refcode=em22_220510_savmil_adv_gq_act___DK_ettx&source=em22_220510_savmil_adv_gq_act___DK_ettx&utm_campaign=em22_220510_savmil_adv_gq_act___DK_ettx&utm_medium=email&em={{EmailAddress%2CDefaultTo%3D}}&fn={{FirstName%2CDefaultTo%3D}}&ln={{LastName%2CDefaultTo%3D}}&pc={{ZipCode%2CDefaultTo%3D}}&contactdata={{ContactData}})
**" A bipartisan bill that will save billions"**
Peter,

Today, I'm proud to share with you the latest legislation coming out of the Select Committee on the Modernization of Congress (or the "Fix Congress" Committee): **the Improving Government for America 's Taxpayers Act.**
One of my main goals in Congress is making sure the government is working for you as effectively and efficiently as possible. Saving taxpayers' money and ensuring that our government is serving the people is something that everyone - Democrats and Republicans - can get behind.

This bipartisan legislation would provide Congress with a layout of achieving significant taxpayer savings via oversight, legislation, and appropriations - and will push for the implementation of U.S. Government Accountability Office recommendations to hold federal agencies accountable and potentially save **billions** of dollars annually.

As Chair of the "Fix Congress" Committee, it's always been my goal to take steps that will make Congress work better for the American people. There's no silver bullet to fix issues we're facing in our government, but I believe the Improving Government for America's Taxpayers Act is a strong step forward.

**[Will you sign on now as a citizen co-sponsor of the Improving Government for America's Taxpayers Act? Please add your name next to mine to help me show Congress this legislation has the people's support.](https://act.myngp.com/el/VGdvqt0VlZIcH0NSS7nAeds-9Q69JjO726QyXe0Hw5s=/imw5xtIwyCZUey0Pv71O3EyQ8KEH6MNkutRfhMdi-ZA=?ms=em22_220510_savmil_adv_gq_act___DK_ettx&refcode=em22_220510_savmil_adv_gq_act___DK_ettx&source=em22_220510_savmil_adv_gq_act___DK_ettx&utm_campaign=em22_220510_savmil_adv_gq_act___DK_ettx&utm_medium=email&em={{EmailAddress%2CDefaultTo%3D}}&fn={{FirstName%2CDefaultTo%3D}}&ln={{LastName%2CDefaultTo%3D}}&pc={{ZipCode%2CDefaultTo%3D}}&contactdata={{ContactData}})**

It's an honor to represent you,

Derek Kilmer

body:
Standing up to scammers and protecting Americans. | | | [ ](https://republicanags.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a0af7b31298ac68022275a138&id=a4db5bb526&e=edf8a4d16d)

| | Friend,

**This is Indiana Attorney General Todd Rokita.**

Last month, [**I filed suit against the organization Black Lives Matter**](https://republicanags.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a0af7b31298ac68022275a138&id=9719d94ea8&e=edf8a4d16d) \- _let me tell you why._

Every political organization has the right to peacefully organize and advocate for their beliefs. _That is part of what makes America exceptional._

However, no non-profit should be able to **scam donors and break the law to enrich themselves. **

Under the guise of _"promoting racial justice,"_ BLM raised over $90 million in 2020 alone. Where is BLM - [led by self-proclaimed 'Marxists'](https://republicanags.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a0af7b31298ac68022275a138&id=e3dcf3903a&e=edf8a4d16d) \- spending all that money? [_**A $6 million lavish mansion in California.**_](https://republicanags.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a0af7b31298ac68022275a138&id=9f68cd87d0&e=edf8a4d16d)

Not just one mansion was enough, however. Last year, [BLM transferred donor money to a Canadian nonprofit](https://republicanags.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a0af7b31298ac68022275a138&id=e70352f4f1&e=edf8a4d16d) \- ran by the wife of BLM's co-founder - _to purchase a $3 million home._

**BLM failed to disclose these purchases** \- keeping the IRS and their own donors in the dark. They've refused to cooperate with a civil investigation into their spending schemes - _but I am committed to getting answers._

Supporters of non-profits - regardless of their politics - deserve to know whether they're getting bamboozled by grifters getting rich off of their good-faith donations.

**Republican Attorneys General are committed to protecting consumers and shining a light on groups like BLM.**

The left's hypocrisy is glaring, and _scammers must be held accountable_. If you are able, [please pitch in a few dollars to support Republican Attorneys General on the frontlines.](https://republicanags.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a0af7b31298ac68022275a138&id=b2da8f5a24&e=edf8a4d16d)

Being a mother is the single greatest gift of my life. But I struggled as a young single mom and even relied on food stamps and waitressing tips to put food on the table. In time, with the help of my family, I worked my way into a better life for myself and my daughter. But what about the women who do not have supportive families, the women who are on their own with nothing and no one to fall back on?

Forcing women through pregnancy, and potentially into a lifetime of poverty, is an intolerable restriction on our basic right to self-determination. One made even more unacceptable in a country that has yet to guarantee paid leave, universal childcare and healthcare to its citizens. And made even more frightening when we see that the same far-right forces that want to overturn _Roe_ are coming for contraception and even seeking to criminalize miscarriage.

Friends, we will not go back. There's too much at stake. We'll keep fighting as long as it takes to win this battle for our reproductive rights. --Eli Mystal, MSNBC_

_"Herschel Walker's candidacy is a white insult to Black people."_

_"I make a hard distinction between Black conservatives and these tokens [referring to me and Senator Tim Scott], who are out here right now, shucking and jiving for their white handlers."_
**That's racist, disgusting, and sad.**

body:
Dear Friend,

Here in Pennsylvania, we're one of a few states where our access to abortion depends on the midterm elections.

Because once Roe v. Wade is overturned this summer, if we elect the wrong leaders, especially if we elect the wrong governor, our abortion rights are out the door. Our state legislators have already been passing anti-abortion laws and the governor's veto is the only thing standing between us and the Dark Ages.

But there's something else you can do TODAY to help support abortion liberation: Tell your senators to vote FOR the Women’s Health Protection Act (WHPA) today.
The WHPA would secure abortion rights nationwide and invalidate terrifying bans around the country, like the ones in Texas and Oklahoma that are either in effect or soon will be.

Send a message HERE TODAY to make sure your senators know that we're watching how they vote — and we want them to vote for WHPA, so that we can have control over our own bodies.

CONTACT YOUR SENATOR [https://keystoneprogressaction.com/our-right-to-control-our-bodies-is-on-the-line/]

Thank you for taking action today, and don't forget to stay engaged with Keystone Progress around the midterm elections. It's up to us to build a progressive PA!

Laura Nevitt
Keystone Progress

| | Throughout my life, I've heard the phrase, "you don't belong here." Sadly, my young sons, just 4 and 6 years old, have already heard similar hurtful words and been labeled in ways they don't yet understand. It's the same phrase we keep hearing in connection with hate crimes against Asian Americans - "you don't belong." Like we aren't _American_ enough. I never want my boys – or any child who calls the United States home – to doubt their place in this country or to feel ashamed of their heritage. No child should ever have to question who they are because of hate or discrimination. **And that's why I'm proud to have helped lead the fight to pass a bill that will take the first meaningful step toward creating a new Asian Pacific American museum in Washington, DC.** The National Museum of Asian Pacific American History and Culture would preserve and honor the culture and contributions of Asian Americans and Pacific Islanders throughout American history. And our contributions have been enormous. But all too often, these contributions go unrecognized. And now with the rising numbers of hate crimes against the AAPI community, we need to come together and promote understanding through learning. We need to send a message to the AAPI community:**You belong here. WE belong here. Our contributions to this country are valued.** Our families' stories are not only Asian American stories. _They're American stories._ I'm going to keep fighting until the doors of the National Museum of Asian Pacific American History and Culture swing open, and I can walk hand in hand with my boys, showing them the myriad contributions from the AAPI community and how we've shaped this country for the better. clean_body: | | | Throughout my life, I've heard the phrase, "you don't belong here." Sadly, my young sons, just 4 and 6 years old, have already heard similar hurtful words and been labeled in ways they don't yet understand. It's the same phrase we keep hearing in connection with hate crimes against Asian Americans - "you don't belong." Like we aren't American enough. I never want my boys – or any child who calls the United States home – to doubt their place in this country or to feel ashamed of their heritage. No child should ever have to question who they are because of hate or discrimination. And that's why I'm proud to have helped lead the fight to pass a bill that will take the first meaningful step toward creating a new Asian Pacific American museum in Washington, DC. The National Museum of Asian Pacific American History and Culture would preserve and honor the culture and contributions of Asian Americans and Pacific Islanders throughout American history. And our contributions have been enormous. But all too often, these contributions go unrecognized. And now with the rising numbers of hate crimes against the AAPI community, we need to come together and promote understanding through learning. We need to send a message to the AAPI community:You belong here. WE belong here. Our contributions to this country are valued. Our families' stories are not only Asian American stories. They're American stories. I'm going to keep fighting until the doors of the National Museum of Asian Pacific American History and Culture swing open, and I can walk hand in hand with my boys, showing them the myriad contributions from the AAPI community and how we've shaped this country for the better. And most importantly, that they matter and they belong here. body:
Together, we can turn our anger and frustration into action, and turn that action into votes and victory on November 8.
#
One thing is clear: **To protect abortion rights in Texas, we must elect Beto as our next Governor.**
Since Justice Alito's draft opinion overturning _Roe v. Wade_ was leaked last week, Beto has not stopped fighting to protect every Texan's — and every American's — right to reproductive freedom. He rallied thousands of folks together in Houston this weekend, launched a day of action with more than 10,000 doors knocked in just one day, and has been on TV sounding the alarm.
We cannot underestimate the stakes. That's why Beto took a minute to speak candidly about what this moment requires of us. [**Please take a moment to watch this video, then contribute $3 or more if you're able to power our campaign to win and protect reproductive rights in Texas.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/bft-em-20220510-1?refcode=ema20220510-188691&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&refcode2=188691_444211_sIA30t&akid=188691%2E444211%2EsIA30t)

**[Contribute $3](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/bft-em-20220510-1?refcode=ema20220510-188691&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=21&refcode2=188691_444211_sIA30t&akid=188691%2E444211%2EsIA30t)**
As Beto explains in the video, Texas is ground zero for these attacks on a woman's right to choose. **And this is exactly where we can end it, and ensure every woman makes her own decisions.**
Together, we can turn our anger and frustration into action and turn that action into votes and victory on November 8. For too long, Texas has been led by a political establishment that ignores the needs of everyday people.
**No more.**
With every $3 donation, door knocked, and phone call made, we move one step closer to electing a Governor who will fight for every woman's freedom to control their own health care, their own body, and their own future.
[**Please, will you chip in now to help elect Beto as the next Governor of Texas and remove Abbott from office?**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/bft-em-20220510-1?refcode=ema20220510-188691&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=22&refcode2=188691_444211_sIA30t&akid=188691%2E444211%2EsIA30t)
Thank you,
Beto for Texas

# ICYMI: Bill McSwain joins Jesse Watters to talk election integrity
**West Chester, Pa.** **\-- ** Republican Candidate for Governor** ** Bill McSwain sat down with Jesse Watters last night to discuss election integrity and his plans to restore election security to Pennsylvania.

McSwain promised to eliminate unconstitutional no-excuse mail-in ballots, and emphasized the importance of electing a conservative outsider to effect permanent change across the Commonwealth:
---
|
> **_"It's going to take a conservative outsider to go to Harrisburg and shake things up. I'm the only candidate for Governor who is not a politician - I'm a Marine, a prosecutor, and a former U.S. Attorney. Restoring election integrity to our state begins with repealing the unconstitutional no-excuse mail-in balloting and returning to the system of in-person voting that has served us well for generations." _**
---
| Watch the full interview here:

| **BACKGROUND: **

Appointed by President Trump, McSwain's record as U.S. Attorney demonstrates his fierce defense of constitutional rights, dedication to upholding law and order, and history of putting criminals and corrupt politicians in jail. Prior to becoming a prosecutor, Bill served as a scout/sniper platoon commander in the U.S. Marine Corps. He was born in Philadelphia and raised in Chester County, where he lives today with his wife, Stephanie, and their four children. name: Herschel Walker
subject: MSNBC: I’m a “token” Black Republican
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY TEAM HERSCHEL, INC
body:
MSNBC invited this man to appear on their network and spew even more anti-Black, anti-conservative vitriol in the name of mediocre TV ratings. |
---
_**"I make a hard distinction between Black conservatives and these tokens [Herschel Walker and Senator Tim Scott], who are out here right now, shucking and jiving for their white handlers."**
--Eli Mystal, MSNBC_

Fellow American,

I recently wrote to you about a racist article attacking me in _The Nation_.

The author had some pretty heinous things to say because I'm a Black conservative. You may recall this line:

_"Herschel Walker's candidacy is a white insult to Black people."_
Well, Fellow American, he's back at it again. MSNBC featured this man on their network this week so he could spew even more anti-Black, anti-conservative vitriol in the name of mediocre TV ratings.

He doubled down in his attacks on me. This time he attacked Republican Senator Tim Scott (SC) too. Here's part of what he said:

_"I make a hard distinction between Black conservatives and these tokens [referring to me and Senator Tim Scott], who are out here right now, shucking and jiving for their white handlers."_
**That's racist, disgusting, and sad.**

I never wanted the color of my skin to be a focal point of this Senate campaign, but these attacks on my character and my skin color have gone too far.

**You can help me prove them wrong by standing with me at this critical moment.**

We'd like to show them a groundswell of grassroots support from across Georgia and around the country. **[Can I count on you to help me today?](http://links.americansfordjt.com/u/click?_t=aff9c7dfb71242f8abc6b00341ebfdb2&_m=224069fcefc24e5e80c95070be124b6e&_e=IWZeBMLipXI0W_XdigNitPev7NbwaYwJJvqYn11TiBwgEmRkpnTKps71MZdD44S01mMvRcC7ToscVQXPVPuWtoaADl_fy6PoK4NjI7aYKgQHIUPjjgO0IyLKxHXZp6x7jKJBCVxLUlZh80JR23vPHkVURIi25_xo-P6faBlMLdLwBjq6AGTZ2GbUFw6yLsqfaWbRMBLNytqGXOHFkBHjoYrJW8zEIJR7tV4jZuc5Ud1tL19wwJfSs1Fqe6UzYT8Xr-_pMqEkkbCiWXVNWUTQnSjRxZUtWElrVXiP5_9Sq1VSvDewSHA8GMUXf0ftgykbyWZCAQLu0qb7bxlZMvNaZWUW3q8a1K2OdcEuDVnn43RO-V5w8qceGR-s5vifKwMO2RjjvfYfugFfIC1ReB0dEQA1wctYqhRozLOUJKfOSMgYw6jd7YP-hKJEbto_jNTVg5lqZA_GNJXxRv9tCp7WTJS3I1M47v_Ogqu4QjTbg8U%3D)**

_Just imagine if these comments were made by a conservative about a Black Democrat. They'd be fired immediately after going off air._

**I won't be quiet about this.** This columnist is saying horrible things about fellow human beings based on the color of their skin. That's simply wrong.

**[We hope you'll take a moment today to support our Senate campaign and show the people who want us to fail just how much support there is for Black conservatives in this country.](http://links.americansfordjt.com/u/click?_t=aff9c7dfb71242f8abc6b00341ebfdb2&_m=224069fcefc24e5e80c95070be124b6e&_e=IWZeBMLipXI0W_XdigNitPev7NbwaYwJJvqYn11TiBwgEmRkpnTKps71MZdD44S01mMvRcC7ToscVQXPVPuWtoaADl_fy6PoK4NjI7aYKgQHIUPjjgO0IyLKxHXZp6x7jKJBCVxLUlZh80JR23vPHkVURIi25_xo-P6faBlMLdLwBjq6AGTZ2GbUFw6yLsqfaWbRMBLNytqGXOHFkBHjoYrJW8zEIJR7tV4jZuc5Ud1tL19wwJfSs1Fqe6UzYT8Xr-_pMqEkkbCiWXVNWUTQnQLeQt-OAMKTgtiDsBsGUq8jCv6V07e_l3PFw0PcfbQDAzM39Y3QcgS4AxIg6gTpBwmAoVhe7lrBUNuJoYuoIzo_njlequG1I6KZdPOEe6gBPKwbXATAApizOMxV-YSCi8RL0I5J2Sbv0AkHBZNonYP8xY4UYwUFV2VGTbWlnTH6RFjB3Yr-80N-AcMeXOZmhE0IoECVmjR6DxcyA0wefVE%3D)**

name: American Update
subject: Survey on an urgent matter
body:
A movement is growing, led by progressives—but supported by many well-meaning Americans—to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution. [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/BC.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c210334%7c9065%7c8%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz%7c805&wdmdk=lZOluHOIXYTzNnuYLL8eFw&sysid=1)
This sponsored message from American Update is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c21895%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=rOE4VtB2TrFQZbu2F2ztWw&sysid=1) Dear Fellow American, I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter. It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation’s future. A movement is growing, led by progressives--but supported by many well-meaning Americans--to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution. That’s why Hillsdale College is conducting a **National Survey on Presidential Selection.** By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue--views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders. You can complete the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c21896%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=Z6dV7Etkuca2nmuAhI3UIw&sysid=1)** For most of our nation’s history, the Electoral College, as devised by the Framers of our Constitution, was not controversial. Indeed, it was considered essential to preserving free and representative government. **But today, more than a dozen states have joined together in an attempt to undermine this constitutional bulwark of liberty.** This movement to undermine the Constitution has grown largely because of the failure of America’s schools to provide young people with a proper grounding in American civics--too many Americans simply don’t understand the importance of the Constitution, including the Electoral College, to liberty. Because of this, Hillsdale College has expanded its educational mission on behalf of liberty nationwide, directly teaching **millions** of Americans in all 50 states. These efforts, which aim to counter the Left’s domination over most of our schools, include:
* **Teaching** millions of citizens nationwide through free online courses, such as “Constitution 101” and “The Great American Story: A Land of Hope;”
* **Reaching** over 5.6 million households and businesses nationwide with _Imprimis_ , Hillsdale’s free digest of liberty;
* **Promoting** constitutional education through social media outlets popular with young people;
* **Sending** millions of pocket-size copies of America’s founding documents to citizens and K-12 schools across America, as well as to members of our armed forces; and
* **Restoring** excellence to K-12 education through Hillsdale’s Barney Charter School Initiative, which launches and provides guidance to classical K-12 charter schools nationwide.

Your answers to the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** will help Hillsdale form the most effective strategy to educate millions of Americans about the importance of the Constitution to liberty--including the importance of the Electoral College. **And this is especially important in this critical time for America’s future.** So please share your views on this urgent topic by completing our **National Survey on Presidential Selection** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. **You can take the survey using this secure link I've provided below:** **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c21896%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=Z6dV7Etkuca2nmuAhI3UIw&sysid=1)** And after you take your survey, I hope you will also consider supporting Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift. Since 1844, Hillsdale has been “pursuing truth and defending liberty.” Today, it does so through its extensive educational outreach efforts, while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. The support of private citizens like you is essential to our work. Please represent your state and take the **National Survey on Presidential Selection today**. Thank you for your time and attention--and for your friendship and support of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844
---
_625 First Street #183, Alexandria, VA 22314_
_[Unsubscribe](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/OptOut.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c210334%7c9065%7c8%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz%7c805&wdmdk=lZOluHOIXYTzNnuYLL8eFw&sysid=1)_

subject: Exciting Campaign Update
body:
We are asking for your help | | | **CLARK BOSSERT for CONGRESS**
---
| |
---
|
---
#### Dear friends of Clark Bossert for Congress,
---
**We just wanted to drop in and give you a quick update:**
---
### Signs are going up, doors are being knocked, and the countdown is on!
---
Last weekend, we were able to put up the **first batch of our road signs** out on the roads. If you live in the southern part of CD3, keep a look out for them! We have many more going up in the next few days as well.
---
|
---
We have also been **knocking doors almost every day,** and are winning many votes across the valley! Clark’s message of defending our constitution, reversing government’s massive overreach into our lives, and keeping America and our families first is really resonating with everyone we meet. It’s exciting to watch.
---
#### We have two big walking days scheduled:

Hello,
Mitch McConnell and Republicans across the country are taking aim at the right to an abortion—and they won’t stop there.
Take a look:
**FIRST** , we learned that the Supreme Court has drafted an opinion to overturn _Roe v. Wade_ , undoing nearly fifty years of precedent for safe and legal abortions.
**THEN** , Mitch McConnell said it’s “possible” a Republican Senate would pass a national abortion ban when the Supreme Court’s ruling goes into effect.
**NOW** , state legislatures like Idaho have said they’re considering restricting access to emergency contraception, like Plan B.
Republicans across the country are doing everything they can to turn back the clock on abortion rights and now they’re signaling a desire to restrict access to contraception. If they succeed, people across the country will suffer and lose their right to live a life they choose. It’s unacceptable, and we must join together and fight back.

Here’s the thing: _If we lose this race and lose the Senate, Republicans could fill the bench with even more extreme conservative justices. They could go even further to infringe on our most fundamental rights._
**That’s why we have to do everything we can to hold onto our Democratic majority.** With the Senate hanging in the balance, electing Peter Welch in Vermont is crucial. But we can’t do it alone.
[**We’re all in to protect access to contraception and safe and legal abortions. We need you on this team—add your name right away.**](https://act.welchforvermont.com/signup/em-protect-right-abortion/?source=%20em_20220510_f_t_bans&t=4&akid=379%2E61531%2EMCO45D)

Jane HOPE Hamilton is exactly the leader we need in Congress.

Logo

Cresco,

Jane HOPE Hamilton is exactly the leader we need in Congress. She has spent over 20 years advocating for North Texas families. From flipping Dallas county Blue in 2006 to delivering President Joe Biden a victory in Texas on Super Tuesday, Jane HOPE has been instrumental in helping elect strong Texas Democrats up and down the ballot.

In Congress, we need an experienced legislator that understands the levers to pull to secure federal funding to grow our economy and develop our communities. Having served in Congress as Marc Veasey’s chief of staff and having worked as a professional staffer on the House Rules Committee, Jane understands how Congress works.

Here are a few things Jane plans to do in Congress:
* Lower the cost of prescription drugs by allowing Medicare to negotiate directly with drug makers.
* Expand Medicaid by cosponsoring the Medicaid Saves Lives Act to provide a federal Medicaid-style program for those living in non-expansion states like Texas.
* Protect social security by opposing all privatization efforts and refusing to raise the retirement age.
* Invest in our public schools by fighting to triple Title I funding.
* Deliver good union paying jobs by advocating to bring federal infrastructure dollars to North Texas.
* Make housing affordable by expanding funding for Section 8 and increasing the housing supply.

Jane HOPE will be a powerful voice for policies that will make a meaningful difference in the lives of North Texans – that is why it is critical we send her to Washington. Please vote for Jane HOPE in Texas’ 30th Congressional District runoff. Early voting runs from May 16 - May 20, and Election Day is May 24.

And if possible, can you kindly consider donating to Jane’s campaign today to help her get across the finish line?

Peter,

I grew up in a union household, the proud daughter of a union pipefitter-welder. In fact, it was my dad's sweatshirt he wore on the job – peppered with burn holes – that I brought with me to Congress. I didn’t bring it with me because I needed a reminder of who I was there to fight for, but because I knew Washington did.

My parents couldn't give me debt-free college or a trust fund, but they gave me something better: they instilled in me the belief that when there's work to be done or a problem to solve, you say "yes." I experienced firsthand how unions are the backbone of working families and the future of America. **Now, despite GOP attacks, workers all across the country are organizing like never before:**
➡️ Amazon just won its first union.
➡️ Starbucks now has its first union.
➡️ Apple stores are getting closer and closer toward unionization.

body:
Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us.
[View this message in your browser](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zdce2h068iaj98prmggrhittus1phhf1m826kcco_rp2ash2s8gb2sbgebjqf99jkgqracjkmoq37d1m65qbfctjmkrncst66uqrf91ieoob9crl6uie5sj2uph70sdjcgqbdd3jm5om3dbhm1ojao376qp77dlhe8o7bdr1cgr61ddme2r71ptnq9o74p1m62p6csjk65r61o5kckoe1d9hcjj6cphhm2pm2ptim1j31c5lmorr1db5e8gq48bi4bh28or5c9h64o34cdj649fg)
This sponsored message from American Action News is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zdjq2v7h2eb60hcuinrtki4mqvcmk53j335sslco_rp22sh2s8i66pb2c9h60p33cph2bs) Dear Fellow American, Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us. This fact means that we’re losing more and more living memory of the greatest armed conflict in human history, which makes the study of World War II even more important. To this end, Hillsdale College has produced an online course entitled “The Second World Wars.” Taught by historian Victor Davis Hanson, this course explores how the conflict’s diverse theaters, belligerents, and ways of fighting came eventually to define a single war. And it examines the key investments, strategies, and leaders that led the Allied powers to victory over the Axis. [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z9uahtk3pv2fsi9jcd0s4dfijbe5cogjr8nvu4m0_rp22sh2s8i66pb2c9h60p33cph2bs) If you’d like to secure a DVD set before they’re all gone, you can get one shipped directly to your home for any gift of $100 or more to Hillsdale College. [And I need to be in Congress next year to stand against the radical left and their obsession with killing babies](https://libersend.lauraloomerforcongress.com/l/jaHkxHkvgw3mMH3vyc0Hsw/ygS9qYBSUeAZ6aYBxsBhMQ/L8RMsxeZ892lDQQqjl0hed0w).

The entirety of the Left-wing political landscape is now extreme - and the Democrat Party is no longer giving a voice to any moderates.

The Left will be hell-bent to win the Mid-Term Elections this year so they can pack the courts and bring back the return of Roe v Wade.

It is more important than ever - more vital than we will see again in our lifetimes - to elect leaders who will STAND THEIR GROUND.

**I am proudly Pro-Life and I don 't budge**.

Not an inch. I never have.

[Help me get to Congress to stand strong against the psychotic Left.](https://libersend.lauraloomerforcongress.com/l/jaHkxHkvgw3mMH3vyc0Hsw/ygS9qYBSUeAZ6aYBxsBhMQ/L8RMsxeZ892lDQQqjl0hed0w)

The Left has no respect for the Sanctity of Life, ethics, rules, or the Law, and now that their beloved Roe v Wade is being overturned, **they will wage war against us**.

And we need PROVEN warriors in Congress who will fight . . . and you know that I will FIGHT. I've proven it again and again for years. [And it will be my honor to prove it again in Congress](https://libersend.lauraloomerforcongress.com/l/jaHkxHkvgw3mMH3vyc0Hsw/ygS9qYBSUeAZ6aYBxsBhMQ/L8RMsxeZ892lDQQqjl0hed0w).

Teachers routinely go above and beyond their job descriptions to help their students thrive. But they’re paid nearly 20% less on average than other college graduates. It’s no surprise, then, that so many schools are struggling to attract and retain qualified teachers.
**Right now, North Carolina’s public elementary schools are facing teacher shortages in all core subjects — and there also aren’t enough substitute teachers to fill the gaps.**
Our students deserve the best possible education. They won’t get it without excellent educators who are able to stay in the profession they love without worrying about making ends meet.

I can tell you with absolute confidence that our democracy is fragile, and that the institutions that make up our democracy don’t defend themselves.

**_People have to do that._**

Think about the extent to which most people, in most places on Earth, in most time periods, did not have the opportunity to decide who would lead them, did not have the opportunity to have a voice in what their laws were. **And we do.** We are the greatest constitutional Republic that has ever existed, and that imposes a real duty on every one of us.

I do not feel burdened by this duty, and neither should any American. To carry on my duty - that is what I have my eyes and my heart set on and why your support of my campaign means so much.

Sincerely,
Liz Cheney

body:
Stay up to date on the latest from Russell Fry's campaign for Congress | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/russellfrysc/russellroundup-8871678?e=7aa6ac5965)
---
| | [ ](https://RussellFrySC.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a41df098de9eb0c2ebc47c51a&id=d11c645933&e=7aa6ac5965)
---
| | It’s the beginning of the week, and that means another installment of **_Russell’s Roundup_** , your weekly source for the latest information on Russell Fry’s campaign to send a true conservative to Congress.
---
|
---
---
| |
**RUSSELL WINS THE DEBATE**
State Rep. Russell Fry received high praise from area Republicans following his performance at Thursday's debate. The message from them – “Russell won, hands down.” **SC House Speaker Jay Lucas:** “The people of SC-07 saw clearly tonight that they have a true leader and conservative fighter in Russell Fry. His preparation and knowledge on the debate stage reflect the good work he will do for you in Congress, as does the tremendous job he has done serving in the SC House for the last 7 years.” **State Representative Phillip Lowe:** “Russell won, hands down. When I endorsed Russell Fry in February, it was because I have seen first-hand that he is a leader for conservatives. Tonight, he did an excellent job reminding voters of his proven conservative record in the State House.” **Florence City Councilman Bryan Braddock:** “We need a fighter in Washington and tonight Russell Fry displayed that he is that fighter. I can’t wait to cast my ballot for him in a few weeks.” **State Representative Heather Crawford:** “The attacks from Russell’s opponents tonight were baseless. I sit next to Russell Fry in the SC House and he doesn’t miss work. I know when he gets to Washington he will display a strong work ethic and defend our conservative values just as he has done in Columbia.” **Don Weaver, Founder of the SC Association of Taxpayers:** "Russell Fry is a taxpayer hero. As chief majority whip, he led the state house this year in passing more income tax relief. He is a conservative champion and a taxpayer hero."
---
|
---
| | [ ](https://RussellFrySC.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a41df098de9eb0c2ebc47c51a&id=abe960713b&e=7aa6ac5965)
---
**CASTING FOR SUPPORT AT THE FISHING RODEO**

What a great way to spend a sunny spring Saturday morning—with families at the DNR Fishing Rodeo near Socastee. Russell enjoyed meeting folks and handing out a few poles to the next generation. Remember, today’s kids will not only be tomorrow’s fishermen and women, but they will also lead South Carolina into the second half of the 21st Century. It was great to see children learning about and appreciating the outdoors. Lots of fish were caught and many happy family memories were made.
---
|
---
| | [ ](https://RussellFrySC.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a41df098de9eb0c2ebc47c51a&id=b29109b3e5&e=7aa6ac5965)
---
**MEETING FOLKS AT THE McCOLL MAYFEST**

The campaign trail then took Russell to the annual McColl Mayfest. Hundreds of folks took advantage of picture-perfect weather to celebrate a return to outdoor fun and nature’s beauty. Russell had a great time meeting so many Marlboro County citizens and sharing with them why it’s so important that we send a Make America Great Again conservative to represent us in Washington.
---
|
---
| | [ ](https://RussellFrySC.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a41df098de9eb0c2ebc47c51a&id=e5f858c1ec&e=7aa6ac5965)
---
**RUSSELL REALLY NEEDS YOUR SUPPORT NOW**

Time is fleeting, the old saying reminds us. That’s especially with the June 14 primary getting closer every day. Friends, our current Congressman is sitting on a bank account so big Ebenezer Scrooge would have been green with envy. With so much at stake for America and South Carolina, we can’t afford to let him buy this election. That’s why Russell Fry is turning to you for help.

Whether you can give $25, $50, $100, or $1,000, any amount you can share is both desperately needed and much appreciated. [_Click here to donate_](https://RussellFrySC.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a41df098de9eb0c2ebc47c51a&id=b04447d7b5&e=7aa6ac5965). And thank you!
---
|
---
| **WE WANT YOU!**
Looking to get involved in Russell’s campaign? With plenty of opportunities available, there’s something for everyone. [_Click here_](https://RussellFrySC.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a41df098de9eb0c2ebc47c51a&id=00a4f773be&e=7aa6ac5965)[ ](https://RussellFrySC.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a41df098de9eb0c2ebc47c51a&id=f89e8cd673&e=7aa6ac5965)to volunteer, and we’ll be in touch with you soon.

**Pssst! PASS IT ON!**
Help spread the word of what Russell is doing here in the 7th Congressional District. Please take a moment and forward this newsletter to 10 of your neighbors, relatives, co-workers, and friends. They’ll be glad you did!

**COUNTDOWN TO ELECTION DAY!**
There are just _**5**_ weeks until polls open on June 14th!

body:
Many Americans have questions and concerns regarding the integrity of the 2020 Presidential election that have yet to be addressed, and we have been.. | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/jeremymunson/breaking-i-am-running-for-congress-in-minnesotas-1st-district-9015669?e=f4c2e54596)
---
|
---
[](https://JeremyMunson.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ed4007ca3497aee312b2b63d0&id=70ed074716&e=f4c2e54596)
Peter,Election integrity is single-handedly **one of the most important issues** we face in the upcoming election. All the candidates are talking about it, but not everyone believes more must be done to ensure the integrity of our elections moving forward.One of my opponents, who is receiving hundreds of thousands in donations from a “centrist” Super PAC that reaches across the aisle and negotiates away our rights with Democrats, told reporters that he would have **voted to certify the results of the 2020 election,**[**contrary to Congressman Hagedorn**](https://JeremyMunson.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ed4007ca3497aee312b2b63d0&id=83592d404a&e=f4c2e54596). Many Americans have questions and concerns regarding the integrity of the 2020 Presidential election that have yet to be addressed, and we have been demonized and treated like second-class citizens by the mainstream media and the Washington establishment for having our suspicions. **Americans for Prosperity** , a political organization that immediately congratulated Biden for winning the election, endorsed my opponent because AFP _refuses to endorse candidates who run on the issue of election integrity_ [**according to the group’s CEO, Emily Seidel**](https://JeremyMunson.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ed4007ca3497aee312b2b63d0&id=887f835c67&e=f4c2e54596).I am the only candidate in this race who called the 2020 election illegitimate. I immediately filed a lawsuit to **prevent the Secretary of State from certifying the 2020 Election**. I fought relentlessly to secure our elections and call out the Democrats for unconstitutionally ignoring election laws during the 2020 Election.
[**We have two weeks to win this election, Peter, and I need all the support I can get to reach as many voters as possible by May 24th. Click here to make a small donation to our grassroots campaign for voter outreach today >>>**](https://JeremyMunson.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ed4007ca3497aee312b2b63d0&id=f3e8088166&e=f4c2e54596)
|
---
|
---
[](https://JeremyMunson.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ed4007ca3497aee312b2b63d0&id=0339aa6a0c&e=f4c2e54596)
|
---
You will hear the same statements about protecting elections from every candidate in this race. I am not going to tell you what I will do, when **I can show you what I did to fight for our President and our elections.**
* I was one of 15 Minnesotans — and the only candidate in this race — who [**signed a letter to Texas Attorney General Ken Paxton**](https://JeremyMunson.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ed4007ca3497aee312b2b63d0&id=4e3d854377&e=f4c2e54596) asking for Minnesota to be included in his lawsuit with the United States Supreme Court.
* I also joined the [**letter from Arizona State Rep Wendy Rogers**](https://JeremyMunson.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ed4007ca3497aee312b2b63d0&id=0f04c3c5ae&e=f4c2e54596)**** calling to throw out all results where elections were deemed fraudulent.
* I was a founding member of the MN Election Integrity Team and filed a lawsuit with the MN Supreme Court to prevent Simon from certifying the 2020 election.
* I authored [**Voter ID, Provisional Balloting, and additional bills**](https://JeremyMunson.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ed4007ca3497aee312b2b63d0&id=5a6f5f9754&e=f4c2e54596) to strengthen our elections.
* I attended an [**Election Integrity Rally outside of the Minnesota State Capitol**](https://JeremyMunson.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ed4007ca3497aee312b2b63d0&id=5e5a4acd74&e=f4c2e54596) to show my support for President Donald J. Trump, where I was attacked by the mainstream media for standing with our President.

[](https://JeremyMunson.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ed4007ca3497aee312b2b63d0&id=20322bbc3a&e=f4c2e54596)
_[**Munson speaks at pro-Trump Election Integrity Rally**](https://JeremyMunson.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ed4007ca3497aee312b2b63d0&id=fb5e598efe&e=f4c2e54596)_
The radical left’s efforts to slow down my fight for election integrity did NOTHING to stop me. I am running for Congress today to fight tooth and nail to stop the Democrats from federalizing our election system and keeping the right to determine elections to our state legislators — It is a lot harder to cheat our system when each state and county conducts its elections in its own way.In two weeks, voters will decide which candidate will best represent Minnesota’s 1st Congressional district. Will we choose the candidate who has done nothing to address voter concerns regarding the integrity of the 2020 election? Or will we choose the candidate who has been standing in trenches with you on this issue since day one?The choice has never been more clear. If you can make a small contribution to help our America-First campaign with voter outreach, please use the following link: [**JeremyMunson.com/Donate**](https://JeremyMunson.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ed4007ca3497aee312b2b63d0&id=fb263637e9&e=f4c2e54596) Thank you for your continued support,
Jeremy Munson
Candidate for Congress
Personal cell: (507) 200-8448

Willes is a founding member of the Trump-Pence Second Amendment Coalition, First Vice President of the National Rifle Association (NRA), a retired Lt. Colonel and combat veteran. Hi Peter, In Ohio, we saw a Donald Trump-endorsed candidate win -- and now, the former failed president is fired up to retake the House in 2022.

Donald Trump has already endorsed the far-right darling in the race for WA-03, so we're building the resources to blast my name across the district to ensure voters know who I am and what we're fighting for.

| Friend,

We are just **30 days from primary ballots dropping into mailboxes** across the state—30 days until Utahns cast the first primary votes.

Antifa and those who support them have left Oregonians to feel afraid of the constant threat of riots, intimidation and harassment.

Just last week in Portland, Antifa thugs showed up to Republican campaign events and threatened attendees and candidates. This is completely unacceptable.

Electing me is the first step to holding these radicals accountable and putting pressure on other members of Congress to investigate these groups and bring them to justice.

Our elected officials in Oregon have handicapped our law enforcement officers from addressing the crimes perpetrated by these extremists. Governor Kate Brown in collusion with her allies in the Democrat Party have turned a blind eye to the wreckage wrought by Antifa and other rioters.

Oregon has had enough.

[I am your law enforcement candidate](https://amyfororegon.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d8661a60d2c62d2072b3f98cb&id=a546b148cb&e=36bbc8e2ca).

Our police officers must be respected. They keep our communities safe and run into the danger for us.

The demagoguery they have experienced over the past several years is entirely unacceptable.

When I am Congress, I will not allow criminals to harass, intimidate or destroy our cities without facing the consequences of their actions. We live in the most beautiful state in the nation and until recently, a very safe and crime controlled state.

We have the opportunity this year to make a change to the direction Oregon is heading and I am excited to lead that movement.

Thank you for your support!

---

Peter,

I have NEVER seen a leak of this magnitude out of the U.S. Supreme Court.

Last week a draft opinion was leaked from our Highest Court. This stunning breach is an assault on the independence of the Supreme Court. Watch the Radical Left escalate its campaign to bully, intimidate and substitute mob rule for the rule of law. **Remember the Kavanaugh hearings?**

Fellow American,

I want to tell you something that’s been on my mind.

Becoming a politician was never my dream. In fact, I didn’t think I was cut out for it. Why? Because I didn’t grow up in this world where everyone knows everyone, and people live in fancy houses, and regular people run for office. _It’s just not me._

**I believe in God, country, and family.** I believe in making it home by 6pm so I can have a conversation with my wife and hear about my daughter’s day at school. I believe in praying before we eat dinner. I believe that God is in control of my life, not the government. I believe in actually being proud of the work that I do _and making a difference for the next generation._ [**I think that Washington could use a little more of that.**](http://links.g4yamerica.com/u/click?_t=cc7dda5c2cc64061900678c88bd3a18a&_m=3bdebe81a6b7411484983fe24e621d8e&_e=p4Z-oHnBlX7_Km-j58DjM6wRXmbEtTDGb5wtV1s9lSWDxrF-XV5URXOtqQi6kgoEzst-QLJjHG38snuPHV0bRmTYfCAyhcYwxTbU_L9AapfVy4avr8SVBRBCxznUVY7ct2LobZpD8HxTiIuyUYT8u0eo85eftVBwwN0DG5XClBc8Ly0qxnhQy3-XtYBN7mncxARVV9gId-nhVx053awsN9ZgaRfk0pDMbF9aRIeW-G9OnuKoKjKLNw8qsfSzTU8JrpVRf0oJB4nHgGXqVFRy9k-e4t7Og_xCGNLa5GlHS0TOzlnozq4xmHpXyny-Wwfl_HkvPgNLhkDdHVGBtYiCkT-1EotfZcMWeMhfLNx7VIgumudPOBN7KeuU7bHWqbDdt5088rnrUOb-UjnBebkh-4fHKtne3ZABITZoQcENzeCD8tzd9tPVBcLHR-ii_EOo-VKO79QgRJ9nTWxBL9NzHpmDwCVMTEqFR9pANh2peSU%3D)

**Congress doesn’t need another Ivy League educated, fast-talking, slick politician whose been served out of a silver spoon their whole life and is beyond out of touch with what matters to real people.**

[**Congress _does_ needs someone like me,**](http://links.g4yamerica.com/u/click?_t=cc7dda5c2cc64061900678c88bd3a18a&_m=3bdebe81a6b7411484983fe24e621d8e&_e=p4Z-oHnBlX7_Km-j58DjM6wRXmbEtTDGb5wtV1s9lSWDxrF-XV5URXOtqQi6kgoEzst-QLJjHG38snuPHV0bRmTYfCAyhcYwxTbU_L9AapfVy4avr8SVBRBCxznUVY7ct2LobZpD8HxTiIuyUYT8u0eo85eftVBwwN0DG5XClBc8Ly0qxnhQy3-XtYBN7mncxARVV9gId-nhVx053awsN9ZgaRfk0pDMbF9aRIeW-G9OnuKoKjKLNw8qsfSzTU8JGUNpzKek_gwyKPVEfHa-JFMnno9BeWrVHpJTfffOIyaYMiVazGC9QRzYpn9ulB8PXQIU-Y1TKyaZYF0LbYjxBGYM3bj0ZeNE0td399-OLWNKASZtGmr6E7y3PWQA7uOidSs_WmHAqdW4YzNdXhxBtddRI4aishnoxNsd0zkmdEpwtRDwL_L2ReayxwyEVhwrP2nhI4OJTgLtsDKp17MxrHLq70uKdqlflm2ycmknjOU%3D) who fills up their own gas at the station, grocery shops with their wife on the weekend, and cracks a beer open with their neighbors to watch football in the fall.

I know the struggles of ordinary life, and I was raised to have a good head on my shoulders. Through Sunday school, I learned important lessons like that you should listen more than you talk, and to be grateful for all of your blessings.

[**Fellow American, it’s people like you and I who SHOULD be representing Americans in Congress – not the elite-circle that currently runs DC.**](http://links.g4yamerica.com/u/click?_t=cc7dda5c2cc64061900678c88bd3a18a&_m=3bdebe81a6b7411484983fe24e621d8e&_e=p4Z-oHnBlX7_Km-j58DjM6wRXmbEtTDGb5wtV1s9lSWDxrF-XV5URXOtqQi6kgoEzst-QLJjHG38snuPHV0bRmTYfCAyhcYwxTbU_L9AapfVy4avr8SVBRBCxznUVY7ct2LobZpD8HxTiIuyUYT8u0eo85eftVBwwN0DG5XClBc8Ly0qxnhQy3-XtYBN7mncxARVV9gId-nhVx053awsN9ZgaRfk0pDMbF9aRIeW-G9OnuKoKjKLNw8qsfSzTU8Jj3MPPA3NLiv2g-sq8-JDUIdo68ZO9tzZtnmL-tqsQqAMVwLdoeqnzyM-Rc4XCWwTLIfLLRje9bOFCVibS_jQmLN2lcU1wS-PDyfCBxmurWCpVf0YW53Yv-k7JQmHWn2wNf-fHMnzzjw7JRto7Fl1jQgaynyedLMEsUNBDZeBrrD-mWcpwuzixLZqLdN-TDjoW0PPPiUMdu8H9_dmu9L72y7ABQhCB8DRtdeV--6JKDo%3D)

[**When I decided to run for Congress the first time, I knew things would be tough.**](http://links.g4yamerica.com/u/click?_t=cc7dda5c2cc64061900678c88bd3a18a&_m=3bdebe81a6b7411484983fe24e621d8e&_e=p4Z-oHnBlX7_Km-j58DjM6wRXmbEtTDGb5wtV1s9lSWDxrF-XV5URXOtqQi6kgoEzst-QLJjHG38snuPHV0bRmTYfCAyhcYwxTbU_L9AapfVy4avr8SVBRBCxznUVY7ct2LobZpD8HxTiIuyUYT8u0eo85eftVBwwN0DG5XClBc8Ly0qxnhQy3-XtYBN7mncxARVV9gId-nhVx053awsN9ZgaRfk0pDMbF9aRIeW-G9OnuKoKjKLNw8qsfSzTU8JszcEqgXhPNzYt1Fi9YfVeglrmdtRxMiZOBFtEtvkF9SREIauH3cFKjveXY4GI_amc5s65HMi3jWTi8kDQzO0-P4n7qSfx5nF4JQ04DzLjjPHgflRpZn2zZhcq1GNG6HNa8f4s2PowRceMgaSkxaDmRVB2w0vfgXwX4gVLj1w9FWjoS2im4tMQL9M2373ULBrmFrkOPPNA6vgfwyUOZ63MDT86k1V7AhZ-FDojNdPU98%3D) I didn’t have the resources, knowledge, or background in politics. clean_body: Congress doesn’t need another Ivy League educated, fast-talking, slick politician whose been served out of a silver spoon their whole life and is beyond out of touch with what matters to real people. | Fellow American, I want to tell you something that’s been on my mind. Becoming a politician was never my dream. In fact, I didn’t think I was cut out for it. Why? Because I didn’t grow up in this world where everyone knows everyone, and people live in fancy houses, and regular people run for office. It’s just not me. I believe in God, country, and family. I believe in making it home by 6pm so I can have a conversation with my wife and hear about my daughter’s day at school. I believe in praying before we eat dinner. I believe that God is in control of my life, not the government. I believe in actually being proud of the work that I do and making a difference for the next generation. Congress doesn’t need another Ivy League educated, fast-talking, slick politician whose been served out of a silver spoon their whole life and is beyond out of touch with what matters to real people. who fills up their own gas at the station, grocery shops with their wife on the weekend, and cracks a beer open with their neighbors to watch football in the fall. I know the struggles of ordinary life, and I was raised to have a good head on my shoulders. Through Sunday school, I learned important lessons like that you should listen more than you talk, and to be grateful for all of your blessings. Here’s the problem though. The reason that the elite run Washington is because they have the funds to do it – but I have you. I didn’t have the resources, knowledge, or background in politics. Heck! I didn’t even have a campaign manager. But as it turns out, other Americans were on the same page as me – we didn’t need another self-serving politician in Washington – we needed a public servant! My message resonated with people, and we ran a historic campaign, losing to a well-funded Democrat by just 2%. I’m running to unseat the same Democrat once again – and like last time, she’s very well-funded. In fact, At the end of the day, I’m a proud father of two, a husband, and a marine who just wants what is best for my family, and for yours. I’ve been to the gas pump recently and I know the toll it’s taking on families. I’ve seen first-hand the anti-American curriculum the Left is pushing down our kids throats and felt powerless in the fight to teach my children what is best. | | **Rep. Marjorie Taylor Greene Spends Donor Cash on $92k SUV**
---
| **DALLAS, Ga** : According to the [Peach Pundit](https://StrahanForCongress.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=21a96cd50be879ed37d24b0ca&id=fe8da0f250&e=daf3f68050), Rep. Greene spent roughly $92,000 of campaign money on a luxury vehicle.

Rep. Greene's campaign spending has been the focus of [recent news articles](https://StrahanForCongress.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=21a96cd50be879ed37d24b0ca&id=8dd6cacf0d&e=daf3f68050), showing she spent more money than she brought in during the first quarter of 2022. Spending $92,000 on a new SUV is far from surprising, considering her lavish trips and hotel stays that also land on her disbursements page. [Constituents are even expressing displeasure with the lack of transparency in her fundraising tactics and spending](https://StrahanForCongress.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=21a96cd50be879ed37d24b0ca&id=4c001e0b27&e=daf3f68050).

As Peach Pundit puts it, "The expenditure will prove controversial as the May 24 primary approaches, not just because of the expensive, swanky nature of the vehicle, but because of Greene's second biggest source of donations is retired Americans – meaning she effectively raided donors' Social Security checks to buy a tricked-out vehicle from a Buick/GMC dealership."

"Like we have been saying all along, Rep. Greene is a fraud. She pretends to be fighting for Georgians, but spends most of her time out of state and serving herself," said Jake Monssen.

"Georgians are tired of the hypocrisy. A common phrase I hear from constituents is 'enough is enough,'" said Jennifer Strahan. "I agree and will put Georgians first if I’m elected."

clean_body: This is why I am in this fight with y’all | | | Hey Peter, I know my campaign sends a lot of emails your way, but I wanted to take a few minutes of your day to talk about why I decided to run for Congress in the first place. A few years ago, I was working for Metro Parks and Recreation (one of the parts of government people are actually happy to see!) but I was still living paycheck to paycheck, even with a master’s degree. So I became an activist because I got sick and tired of seeing so many people scraping and clawing just to get by on the poverty line, and I knew there’s something fundamentally wrong with the systems that we have. First, I co-founded Stand Up Nashville, fighting to empower my working-class community here at home. And last year, I decided to run for Congress because I wanted to give voice and power to those across Tennessee who have been left behind for far too long. I knew that I had friends who would help us. But I also knew that we’d have to talk to so many people (and make new friends) across our state in order to earn their support and be able to power this campaign. That’s why emails like this are so important to this race, and why your support is so important. So I’m humbly asking you: If you've stored your info with ActBlue Express, we'll process your contribution instantly: None of this would be possible without your grassroots support — yes, really, yours! Thank you, good people! —Odessa | To give by check: Odessa for Congress 2817 West End Ave, Ste 126-401 Nashville, TN 37203

That sounds nice and all, but the truth is that Zeldin has previously signed onto an amicus brief to overturn _Roe v. Wade_ and promised to appoint an anti-choice health commissioner if he’s made governor.
**Don’t be fooled: Zeldin is dangerous, and reproductive rights are NOT safe in New York with Republicans in power.**
We need bold, progressive leaders in Congress to do what it takes to protect abortion access everywhere: codify _Roe_ into federal law and expand the Supreme Court to ensure it’s never undone by the GOP.
I’m the only candidate in this race for NY-03 calling for these actions, and I promise to fight for reproductive choice with everything I’ve got in Congress.

Friend, As a homeschool mom and a former bilingual kindergarten teacher, I know that every child in the United States deserves a quality education. Parents and teachers both play a big role in ensuring children are equipped to handle life as adults.

[**Stand up for students!**](http://links.sheddforaz.com/u/click?_t=aef90635dd7e4e83bfd7b3a79f893ad5&_m=b293841086c44e9c9bc803ca1aaeab94&_e=0Tpj5Db9ex6WXItqzSxOhIZZW588qPHrora-911C7FQ0r3iYQmT6_iSBuxVyAxck2-ZWAYmQ4rf5hSChqdtBu3cYAA2HghALk2vTh78bGHatSK6Ve30MGhordE1msRypUQ4b5sqi63fjTDE4zfLi_HnKlvOeG-bSuZT_Y2UGsL4zjyklHzqYk3lo1Co2z9se58uncqVGGuvj-G2W6ADfSBLEcmkJOmWT-yn_lgwkoYUPPLReZRJqqybPQw-qBqTty9f5tQ-BuCdGr1UZY62WiREMsnbfWCRGDWUv9G5Re31qNas2IV_VIOGSQcI4OYdyOIo60po22yDP6S9PumGESyMXmEK5SoeP-lqyTzlOePvx5YtYpLU9u7rmMZfnmGbHM3ljsSzmmL9nFsArJJqkCd72ifS3fYipAQSaHA8dw1TwJYdbFRu9UnSrQo3D-l1MEuEapOWZbkO6qaTa1judec0PhF7w-PxRffPATZIS8DSG8q38lE3ZfYajBFy2mrgN)

Sadly, the left is more concerned about pleasing their teachers union donors than delivering quality education for children. Over the past two years, we’ve seen attempts by Joe Biden and his Democrat enablers to curtail parental involvement in **THEIR OWN CHILDREN’S** education. Left-wing progressives advocate for less transparency in the classroom, less accountability for educational bureaucrats, and fewer choices for parents in choosing how to educate their children. They advocate for a one-size-fits-all model for every student and oppose an education system specially tailored to every student’s needs. Teachers unions are ready to spend **MILLIONS and MILLIONS** to achieve their goal of implementing an unaccountable, school system that eschews the needs of parents and students. One union leader even [compared school choice advocates to Russian propagandists](http://links.sheddforaz.com/u/click?_t=aef90635dd7e4e83bfd7b3a79f893ad5&_m=b293841086c44e9c9bc803ca1aaeab94&_e=0Tpj5Db9ex6WXItqzSxOhJaF6fACkFJ0uy71yG9qEXPSU4H4TYn7YMMYp9YjOCt9DzNs3kxQTqgPROOr2GD4ggduTiManMHNLRuZuPLB0de8SsBNfjsja0Ijou6HGgdhFmAjnZfNBLFSK0_bA2SQWn5Ffla6Nt-34jRacF_srp-qiYr88RROMkyo9tVPfXwSDpo2SnJkT3k7MHM9-KeSQyfBwvEzYm6GjEgv2iNhQo8pZsv8YEnQ-wv0cPnBljvGrRetTgPcn6CPiDVuJI19BiWh_7Tmy3gp1Hkc3OwYOv16FTgExBCslsBmn14cbPpJ3OAoI5Q4s4vdUBAWPJOUKA%3D%3D). **In America our children belong to families - NOT the government!** Friend, the teachers unions might have millions of dollars, but I have the backing of grassroots patriots across Arizona. **We the people won’t be bought out by big unions and special interests.** I know you are a top patriot and won’t sit idly by as parents are excluded from decisions regarding their children’s education. **Herschel's Democrat opponent, Senator Raphael Warnock, votes with President Biden nearly 100% of the time, despite President Biden only winning in Georgia by 11,779 votes out of more than 4.9 million cast in 2020.**

_A senator from a purple state that Biden barely won would normally be very careful about voting with an unpopular president. But that's not the case in Georgia, and the stats prove it. Senator Warnock's voting record is out of touch with Georgia's electorate, and he needs to go._

Fellow American, Democrats are not going to give this seat up without a fight. It's going to be nasty. And they'll have the money to say anything they want on television, radio, and the internet.

If this election is as close as everyone thinks it's going to be, **it will get harder and harder to win if we are massively outspent.** Money isn't everything, but it can make a real difference in a close race.

| | Dear Peter, **** Over the past week, millions of Americans have taken to the streets to defend the rights of women, girls, non-binary, and trans folks. Meanwhile, the powerful leader among House Democrats, Nancy Pelosi, has continued raising money for anti-choice reproductive authoritarian Rep. Henry Cuellar (D-TX). [**Had enough? Join us today to take action at Pelosi’s house in Pacific Heights!**](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/P8Elou2Rvc0qoMPEUZrMXcOpy_XqN4R2ZGjoK-5zZnkxX3ah5QHi27_S3hqiq7heloph6udnXFt5vQyHsdlVJNkK77HGAzEyDuoxQw1VkWMjZd_y_E0aOvxsOWsp0tI7jtK431FzICpQKejnQTYe0ng_tN1mH03LU3tx90RHCDhdkEwn3P9ThZAtw7Q5elbVB_HoxhfocPsAfuzOgkDtaSYcFChPb7DhrzboXoKeS2DMmxzljOXID7zulq651YJD1VvzTJ6qMBRKNX7bv4J734-VhAna0P0Mmrw-TpGmTsJAUv03shEiWwj3Z1uq2eQQwAAXIIBVCKumyupQmXiKsEhFVana8Yivm5EirDDFH7yEkZ_ZTGm3g-pP8HjvLrLI/3lx/FlTT4vd4QJimIFehi2J-vA/h0/aCMoevPdL5BYoCje0zuQX3dNB3ioK68Wh-G_r5LKLBs) The layers of hypocrisy that Pelosi embodies can sometimes grow difficult to overstate. Having failed to codify _Roe_ when Democrats held the Senate, she more recently failed to block Justice Barrett’s confirmation hearings when she had a chance, and absurdly continues to raise money for anti-choice Democrats! Just yesterday, Pelosi was quoted by _The Hill_ as saying, “I want the Republican Party to take back the party to where you were when you cared about a woman’s right to choose, you cared about the environment. Here I am, Nancy Pelosi, saying this country needs a strong Republican Party.” [**Would you rather see Democrats championing for a strong Democratic Party than a strong Republican one? It’s not rocket science, but we need your help to overcome Pelosi’s corruption and invite you to join us at her house today!**](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/P8Elou2Rvc0qoMPEUZrMXcOpy_XqN4R2ZGjoK-5zZnkxX3ah5QHi27_S3hqiq7heloph6udnXFt5vQyHsdlVJNkK77HGAzEyDuoxQw1VkWMjZd_y_E0aOvxsOWsp0tI7uR3V8Sl_8sf33S25hz8Qa7GMtGBIx3Kca1anyNklg41KchOuw6pUX26twd76fPLmVgTY5bUzlbL_jV6yyiFIu5hPO-D14-RLryMiHywF_KxD_ubp3ybm5-98FuMU2EzuQxsjK7Ie4Pt1PsE0ci1FdM6sEjrSMhywOQf7qefxbn0GyKrcJMNTWtLgfsAxM9fe4DHVU2d_nun17yLankozkvLJl3FvDBAYY_JhHKcPOjDMeVEItu3miPLkITXmye1E/3lx/FlTT4vd4QJimIFehi2J-vA/h1/F3CA5ltTKKdU_Q1JAf7ziFYYM_mRFzkzHw3b_2VwEnk) We appreciate the demand by grassroots organizers calling for Pelosi to investigate Republican-appointed Justices. We extend that request to the Senate Judiciary Committee, and also expand on their demands in two ways. First, I proposed ten years ago that Congress end judicial life tenure, in order to force long overdue turnover on the bench and check & balance a judiciary run amok. That proposal has grown only more urgent in the time since then. Second, we’ve more recently proposed that blue states immediately begin passing bills to enact boycotts of red states should _Roe_ fall, in order to force the Justices to reconsider their opinions before the leaked draft opinion is formalized. We know that the Court has grown politicized in spite of its design, and also that Washington cares more about capital than our communities. Even if the Justices are not formally politically accountable, a threat to commerce offers the chance to sway them before it grows too late. While media sources have widely dropped the ball by failing to cover our race or the impending jungle primary election, we anticipate media coverage of today’s event and encourage you to attend if you’re available. See you at the corner of Normandie Terrace & Broadway at 5pm! Your voice,

body:
Alexandria just made two new endorsements for the 2022 election cycle.
# [](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/143?refcode=em20220510-3013-header&t=1&akid=3013%2E2526796%2ExCWC1j)
Alexandria just made two new endorsements for the 2022 election cycle.
**We’re proud to be supporting two strong progressives who are running for Congress: Summer Lee and Nida Allam!**
Nida and Summer are both facing primary elections on May 17 (that’s just one week away) and are up against powerful special interests who are spending millions to defeat them.
[If you’re able to, can you please split a $9 contribution between Nida Allam, Summer Lee, and our campaign? Together we must elect a Congress that stands with working people, not corporate interests.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/aoc-email-20220510-1?refcode=em20220510-3013-P_FND_SPL_END&t=2&refcode2=3013_2526796_xCWC1j&akid=3013%2E2526796%2ExCWC1j)
**[Contribute $9](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/aoc-email-20220510-1?refcode=em20220510-3013-P_FND_SPL_END&t=21&refcode2=3013_2526796_xCWC1j&akid=3013%2E2526796%2ExCWC1j)**
Here is a little more info about these excellent candidates:
**Nida Allam:** Nida is running in North Carolina’s 4th district. This seat opened up for the first time in years when Democrat David Price announced his retirement. If elected, Nida will be the youngest woman ever elected to Congress at just 28 years old (a title previously held by Alexandria at 29) – and the first Pakistani-American member.
In 2020, Nida ran an unprecedented progressive campaign for Durham County Commissioner, where she became the first Muslim woman elected to public office in North Carolina and fought to raise the minimum wage and provide property tax relief for low-income people. Now she is ready to fight for a progressive agenda in Congress.
Nida will fight to enshrine Roe as the law of the land. After news broke of the draft SCOTUS decision on Roe, Nida said: “When they come for our right to choose, they’re coming for our right to our lives. We can’t let them take it."
**Summer Lee:** Summer is running in Pennsylvania’s 12th district. With longtime Democrat Mike Doyle retiring, Pittsburgh will elect a new representative in Congress for the first time in 25 years.
As a Pennsylvania state legislator and dedicated organizer, activist, and attorney – Summer has fought tirelessly to lift up movements and transform her community. When she first ran for State House in 2018, she took on a 20-year incumbent, doubled voter turnout, and won. Now, she is running for Congress to deliver for the working class.
[Nida and Summer are up against everything the establishment can throw at them, and we need to send them as much grassroots support as possible. Can you please split a $9 contribution today?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/aoc-email-20220510-1?refcode=em20220510-3013-P_FND_SPL_END&t=22&refcode2=3013_2526796_xCWC1j&akid=3013%2E2526796%2ExCWC1j)
It matters a great deal what kind of Democrats fill these seats. Nida and Summer will fight for their communities and that’s why we’re proud to be mobilizing Team AOC volunteers to lead phone banks and recruit more volunteers for their campaigns.
Thank you so much for everything and stay tuned for more ways you can support their campaigns.
In solidarity,
Team AOC
P.S. We need volunteers to help contact voters before Tuesday’s primary! If you’re able to, please sign up to [**join a Summer Lee phone bank here**](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/13645?source=em20220510-3013&utm_source=em20220510-3013&t=23&akid=3013%2E2526796%2ExCWC1j) or a [**Nida Allam phone bank here**](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/13646?source=em20220510-3013&utm_source=em20220510-3013&t=24&akid=3013%2E2526796%2ExCWC1j).

**[Donate](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/aoc-email-20220510-1?refcode=em20220510-3013-P_FND_SPL_END&t=25&refcode2=3013_2526796_xCWC1j&akid=3013%2E2526796%2ExCWC1j)** | **[Merch](https://shop.ocasiocortez.com/?utm_source=em-footer-20220510-3013-P_FND_SPL_END&t=26&akid=3013%2E2526796%2ExCWC1j)**

| | | Folks,

The November election is going to be an uphill battle. On paper, the odds seem to be against us especially with the recent gerrymander on our congressional district maps. BUT . . .

**I’ve always believed that with the power of organizing, people exercising their right to free speech and right to vote, we can overcome even the worst of odds. But, organizing and letting people know that there is a viable alternative and a path to victory available takes money, and your contribution will help us get that message out.**

[**Make a difference today by joining our Monthly Sustainers Club!**](https://MikeVanSomeren.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a8d3e4f455e56b0d81700f39a&id=8940bed68d&e=356c0699dd)

A lot of people don’t think they have enough money for their donations to matter, especially in light of all of the big money interests that constantly fund politicians. BUT, the average congressional district has over **700,000** citizens in it. If even 10% of those citizens contribute **$3** in a month, that would raise an immediate **$210,000! **

**That’s enough to compete with any big-money interest group.** If those same folks make that same contribution a recurring monthly contribution, by the time the election rolls around in November it could raise a whopping **$1,470,000!** This is the power of the grassroots. This is how you take back control of our democracy from the corporate elite that want to buy elections.
---
| [JOIN MONTHLY SUSTAINERS CLUB](https://MikeVanSomeren.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a8d3e4f455e56b0d81700f39a&id=9fdce9a617&e=356c0699dd "JOIN MONTHLY SUSTAINERS CLUB")
---
|
---
| **I’m running for Congress to bring common-sense leadership to Washington.** We need to help the everyday American putting in an honest days’ work get ahead, while ensuring that programs are available for those that need help to get back on their feet. We need to focus on rebuilding the American middle class, so everyone gets a fair shake. We all deserve to own a home, raise our families, meet basic expenses, and save for a rainy day.

**Scott Fitzgerald refuses to work for the middle class. YOU deserve better. **

[**With only six months left until the election, I’m asking you to become part of our Monthly Sustainers Club by setting up a monthly donation of $25, $10, or even just $3, less than the cost of two cups of coffee.**](https://MikeVanSomeren.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a8d3e4f455e56b0d81700f39a&id=591ac49bbb&e=356c0699dd)

| **By setting up a monthly recurring contribution, you become a member of this campaign’s strongest supporters, and allow us to make critically important financial decisions by knowing we can count on your continued support. **

Thank you so much for considering this unique opportunity to join our campaign’s Monthly Sustainers Club and rising to the next level in your dedication to fixing the broken system in Washington.

With much gratitude,

Mike Van Someren

--Eli Mystal, MSNBC_

_"Herschel Walker's candidacy is a white insult to Black people."_
