Fellow American,

I want to tell you something that’s been on my mind.

Becoming a politician was never my dream. In fact, I didn’t think I was cut out for it. Why? Because I didn’t grow up in this world where everyone knows everyone, and people live in fancy houses, and regular people run for office. _It’s just not me._

**I believe in God, country, and family.** I believe in making it home by 6pm so I can have a conversation with my wife and hear about my daughter’s day at school. I believe in praying before we eat dinner. I believe that God is in control of my life, not the government. I believe in actually being proud of the work that I do _and making a difference for the next generation._ [**I think that Washington could use a little more of that.**](http://links.americansfordjt.com/u/click?_t=aff9c7dfb71242f8abc6b00341ebfdb2&_m=1b14d600cbee48c88e8e283e2852ca51&_e=dZRar8yC6fRpqaQUpdejLtmcqjfEr3TMgR7Cxk6y0uI-csGm93uIo9_GNV7KsCsobYu5XmuLXte4KfvX1P_JZmmfXoCdNT9JZopVhZmHCuzqeq5UYX9vKH5ICSVlloMQ3t9RZd8Nfm48-ul1qryCSsojwDgXiOWhWB61RiBzNCNGEa4oJMn_Yvf4808rVzOy_omEuk2klGHkJkjWx0uS0aWXa5ACI81aQX1fQK3k562zgjrlu_Jt0WbJZ59dRqpbMB0Y2nDmr78AMWsKQqGL1gEy-f0KoG8cW-oW0nyp1KFdAv6epREGSnTe_g2qJrjIGa7JxD3OLSFKZ68hC12NwI741i04Q_ZZDB0QhmHMqKx0jL1rVsix8YlZR2PmONdBib35h5FzfOWPtzPrzWZ6zGWUwMfBHMs0bPvhzV2fnL1qcajwh_lbmCAihP9eHykD0yNvjKzIPx1u_WMzBzdXdgtt_YB-mvXQQQO9ihnLIq4%3D)

**Congress doesn’t need another Ivy League educated, fast-talking, slick politician whose been served out of a silver spoon their whole life and is beyond out of touch with what matters to real people.**

[**Congress _does_ needs someone like me,**](http://links.americansfordjt.com/u/click?_t=aff9c7dfb71242f8abc6b00341ebfdb2&_m=1b14d600cbee48c88e8e283e2852ca51&_e=dZRar8yC6fRpqaQUpdejLtmcqjfEr3TMgR7Cxk6y0uI-csGm93uIo9_GNV7KsCsobYu5XmuLXte4KfvX1P_JZmmfXoCdNT9JZopVhZmHCuzqeq5UYX9vKH5ICSVlloMQ3t9RZd8Nfm48-ul1qryCSsojwDgXiOWhWB61RiBzNCNGEa4oJMn_Yvf4808rVzOy_omEuk2klGHkJkjWx0uS0aWXa5ACI81aQX1fQK3k562zgjrlu_Jt0WbJZ59dRqpb7ZQr1q7Ytl8mDcaMIgUVAniSlCJcnVV_23sVhjZplKIIQR7dpNWZnB3bb02Kq9d_3xSOQeGQF-yNK6ou8UZb0bvCdICAP8OpRnE6vWTO_enZNl5_j0JfVKu5x3PnFKZSLN3q2mPKCYk-jtCyI406lMHoVt-4TujfW5gqdELqkYeXh5RHJh4YGfotQULBMggkamyuPV0uDTVJvtfdLiyPFldKXe4lcmDM-dgeVTCDHdE%3D) who fills up their own gas at the station, grocery shops with their wife on the weekend, and cracks a beer open with their neighbors to watch football in the fall.

I know the struggles of ordinary life, and I was raised to have a good head on my shoulders. Through Sunday school, I learned important lessons like that you should listen more than you talk, and to be grateful for all of your blessings.

[**Fellow American, it’s people like you and I who SHOULD be representing Americans in Congress – not the elite-circle that currently runs DC.**](http://links.americansfordjt.com/u/click?_t=aff9c7dfb71242f8abc6b00341ebfdb2&_m=1b14d600cbee48c88e8e283e2852ca51&_e=dZRar8yC6fRpqaQUpdejLtmcqjfEr3TMgR7Cxk6y0uI-csGm93uIo9_GNV7KsCsobYu5XmuLXte4KfvX1P_JZmmfXoCdNT9JZopVhZmHCuzqeq5UYX9vKH5ICSVlloMQ3t9RZd8Nfm48-ul1qryCSsojwDgXiOWhWB61RiBzNCNGEa4oJMn_Yvf4808rVzOy_omEuk2klGHkJkjWx0uS0aWXa5ACI81aQX1fQK3k562zgjrlu_Jt0WbJZ59dRqpbTTmHZc9nIZycozfamNRyoKKJh0iPuWZ2ug0ElvLwFi5Gt9RhBn-OmIjJ1Yj4Q0CYRoadlT9g8EszPqKVmB1aJIX0749CSJ0mU5S-jn36IixV6jFGoSzOcH5gUJwM7desNeC_BOoHIRY3Vr4PjVKsqL3I5GWIbjsx3Qj0WC9MkTvm2WeUjs3p6sJToADEb9-yynwmdC72P-jI9zXtWG04vKy_8F9j4OJpPji6j4wsQJI%3D)

clean_body: Congress doesn’t need another Ivy League educated, fast-talking, slick politician whose been served out of a silver spoon their whole life and is beyond out of touch with what matters to real people. | Fellow American, I want to tell you something that’s been on my mind. Becoming a politician was never my dream. In fact, I didn’t think I was cut out for it. Why? Because I didn’t grow up in this world where everyone knows everyone, and people live in fancy houses, and regular people run for office. It’s just not me. I believe in God, country, and family. I believe in making it home by 6pm so I can have a conversation with my wife and hear about my daughter’s day at school. I believe in praying before we eat dinner. I believe that God is in control of my life, not the government. I believe in actually being proud of the work that I do and making a difference for the next generation. Congress doesn’t need another Ivy League educated, fast-talking, slick politician whose been served out of a silver spoon their whole life and is beyond out of touch with what matters to real people. who fills up their own gas at the station, grocery shops with their wife on the weekend, and cracks a beer open with their neighbors to watch football in the fall. I know the struggles of ordinary life, and I was raised to have a good head on my shoulders. Through Sunday school, I learned important lessons like that you should listen more than you talk, and to be grateful for all of your blessings. Here’s the problem though. The reason that the elite run Washington is because they have the funds to do it – but I have you. I didn’t have the resources, knowledge, or background in politics. Heck! I didn’t even have a campaign manager. But as it turns out, other Americans were on the same page as me – we didn’t need another self-serving politician in Washington – we needed a public servant! My message resonated with people, and we ran a historic campaign, losing to a well-funded Democrat by just 2%. I’m running to unseat the same Democrat once again – and like last time, she’s very well-funded. In fact, At the end of the day, I’m a proud father of two, a husband, and a marine who just wants what is best for my family, and for yours. I’ve been to the gas pump recently and I know the toll it’s taking on families. I’ve seen first-hand the anti-American curriculum the Left is pushing down our kids throats and felt powerless in the fight to teach my children what is best. I hope I can count on your support today, so we can shake up Washington together. In service, Tyler Kistner Father. Husband. Ally is a classic conservative and the only candidate speaking to the heart of Utah.

| Dear Friend,
I can't believe that just 7 weeks from today we'll cast our ballots in the Utah Republican Primary for the U.S. Senate. I'm hoping over the next 7 weeks I can earn your trust and reinforce why I'm the best person to represent Utah in Washington, D.C.
The time for flashy turns of phrase and quick one liners is over. We need real conversations about what change in Washington means for Utah, and why I am the change and voice Utah needs.
Honestly, we heard the reason today when President Biden placed the blame for inflation and a troubled economic future on Republicans. Unbelievable. He spent time on a partisan distraction and not talking about real solutions. More of the same old, same old we expect from D.C.'s career elites.
But how does changing our Republican senator in Utah affect what a Democrat-controlled Presidency, Senate, and House does?
It's simple.
We need new voices speaking truth in clear terms. Then we need real action to ensure those ideas are put in motion.
Nothing is working right now in D.C. Nothing.
U.S. citizens are a partisan rope in a never-ending tug-of-war. That rope is fraying. We are tired of the senseless fighting and division.
That's why I'm running, and that's why I'm asking for your vote. We need to get D.C. to work for us - We the People - and we need new voices with new thinking to make it happen.
It really is that simple.
Please follow our Republican Renaissance on our social media platforms today and vote for me, Ally Isom, on June 28th.
Thanks and let's talk again soon, Ally

body:

#
Hey Derek,
We have _< checks notes>_ one week left until the people of Pennsylvania choose their Democratic nominee for Senate.
That means we have one week to ensure all our supporters get their ballots in the door.
One week to get our message out in all 67 Counties.
**One week to lock in this win.**
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220510-2?refcode=em20220510-5752&refcode2=5752_434096_Pb1xHC&akid=5752%2E434096%2EPb1xHC)
[**Please. will you help me make the most of the one week we have left by kicking in your first $5 right now? It all comes down to the next seven days.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220510-2?refcode=em20220510-5752&refcode2=5752_434096_Pb1xHC&akid=5752%2E434096%2EPb1xHC)

Btw. I’ve got another exciting piece of news.
We are *thiiiiis* close to reaching a major milestone: **200,000** unique grassroots donors!
Derek, that’s not just some number — it’s proof we’ve built a historic grassroots movement. Each and every donation is literal proof that people believe in our campaign for working people.
I’m overwhelmed with gratitude that nearly 200,000 folks, from all 67 PA counties and more than 50% of U.S. zip codes, have put their faith in us. 😭
While my rich Republican opponents are propping up their campaigns with millions of their own dollars, we're powered by folks who chip in $5, $25, or $100 at a time.

You can chip in as little as $3, and you could be the one to put us over the top of 200,000 grassroots donations — not to mention help fuel our final primary push.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220510-2?refcode=em20220510-5752&refcode2=5752_434096_Pb1xHC&akid=5752%2E434096%2EPb1xHC)**

Team Fetterman HQ

| | Dear ,
Did they really think they could kick me off the ballot?

_I don’t think so._

America First is here to stay. Election Integrity is here to stay. No matter what curveballs the Left throws, Arizona WILL become the GOLD STANDARD of Election Integrity.

In breaking news, the Arizona Supreme court just ruled that I will remain on the Arizona ballot. They tried with everything they had – they threw the kitchen sink at me, but that couldn’t stop Mark Finchem. That couldn’t stop the wildfire movement that we have built from the ground up.

[_Help the Election Integrity movement today with a generous donation!_](https://votefinchem.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a653829701c13e4a704cb19bf&id=c972d51cc2&e=44b8c466b0)
---

---
| The Left was literally trying to dig up Civil War legal provisions to get me off the ballot.

_Arizona Public Media_ reports:

_The Arizona Supreme Court will allow three Republican lawmakers to stay on the ballot after opponents argued they should be disqualified because they participated in or helped organize the January 6, 2021 rally in Washington, D.C. that ended with an attack on the U.S. Capitol._

_The group Free Speech for People argued Congressmen Paul Gosar and Andy Biggs as well as state Rep. Mark Finchem should be barred from the ballot under a Civil War-era provision of the U.S. Constitution that says any public official who participates in an insurrection cannot hold office._

_But the court said that while the lawsuits were filed under a state law for challenging candidates' qualifications, that law does not allow challenges under Section 3 of the 14th Amendment. Instead, the court said the Constitution appears to give Congress the exclusive authority to enforce that provision._

name: Jayapal HQ
subject: Nobody is above the law. Not even a Supreme Court justice.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Pramila for Congress
body:
We can no longer stand by while our judges and justices take advantage of our system to build wealth and power at the expense of our country’s most marginalized.
#
Peter, ethics scandals have plagued our federal courts for decades.
Clerks accuse federal judges of sexual misconduct with little to no recourse. A Supreme Court justice decides cases about an election that his wife tried to overturn. And that's just the tip of the iceberg. _It's absurd._
**A system without basic ethics is a corrupt system.** That’s why Pramila is teaming up with Senator Elizabeth Warren to introduce the Judicial Ethics and Anti-Corruption Act to overhaul our country’s judicial ethics laws and restore public faith in our court system. [**Can you help Pramila build critical support for this bill so it gets a vote in the House and Senate by adding your name as a citizen co-sponsor today?**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/signup/judicial-ethics-and-anti-corruption/?refcode=em20220510-1251&t=1&akid=1251%2E420207%2EG7c4g0)
**[Add your name »](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/signup/judicial-ethics-and-anti-corruption/?refcode=em20220510-1251&t=2&akid=1251%2E420207%2EG7c4g0)**
We can no longer stand by while our judges and justices take advantage of our system to build wealth and power at the expense of our country's most marginalized. **If passed and sent to President Biden's desk, Pramila's bill with Senator Warren will:**
* Ban federal judges from owning conflicted assets;
* Strengthen restrictions on judicial gifts and privately funded travel;
* Require the Supreme Court to adhere to a binding Code of Conduct;
* Provide more information to the public by improving disclosure in the federal judiciary;
* And so much more.

Pramila said it best: Nobody is above the law. Not even a Supreme Court justice. [**If you agree, add your name as a citizen co-sponsor of the Judicial Ethics and Anti-Corruption Act to ensure a fair and balanced judicial system that fulfills its promise of equal justice under the law.**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/signup/judicial-ethics-and-anti-corruption/?refcode=em20220510-1251&t=3&akid=1251%2E420207%2EG7c4g0)
Thanks for joining Pramila in this fight, Peter.
In solidarity,
Team Jayapal

name: Herschel Walker
subject: DISGUSTING: “Shucking and jiving for their white handlers.”
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY TEAM HERSCHEL, INC
body:
MSNBC invited this man to appear on their network and spew even more anti-Black, anti-conservative vitriol in the name of mediocre TV ratings. |
---
_**"I make a hard distinction between Black conservatives and these tokens [Herschel Walker and Senator Tim Scott], who are out here right now, shucking and jiving for their white handlers."**
--Eli Mystal, MSNBC_

Peter,

I recently wrote to you about a racist article attacking me in _The Nation_.

The author had some pretty heinous things to say because I'm a Black conservative. You may recall this line:

_"Herschel Walker's candidacy is a white insult to Black people."_
Well, Peter, he's back at it again. MSNBC featured this man on their network this week so he could spew even more anti-Black, anti-conservative vitriol in the name of mediocre TV ratings.

He doubled down in his attacks on me. This time he attacked Republican Senator Tim Scott (SC) too. Here's part of what he said:

_"I make a hard distinction between Black conservatives and these tokens [referring to me and Senator Tim Scott], who are out here right now, shucking and jiving for their white handlers."_
**That's racist, disgusting, and sad.**

I never wanted the color of my skin to be a focal point of this Senate campaign, but these attacks on my character and my skin color have gone too far.

**You can help me prove them wrong by standing with me at this critical moment.**

We'd like to show them a groundswell of grassroots support from across Georgia and around the country. **[Can I count on you to help me today?](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=65f3efec361b4ea6b94e5a1125a40826&_e=Qiskcf3e0wlRem09PBEbbsnbUjJ3WOAsSkv71xM0vK3uEeAMOLPcRCqM5F0hneLm3A1XzYmHG1AukNelxclYYrrGzXoqhfQuGhQScL3G5hySdVzGSTXUs8gn0MVqWrO0P3_Q-zLy9CfMsRPa3XAAnQA9JQzDmSH3gFsFGvWZBiZrsq4OiTqfqJnD0cyLEcFQxlEUTHjPrerm7MnVvozWyx9SDn8zNUv7uwaNNKNIr5Xs0Euqzg7Ja7mn3-eSKP91uXCm67lr0O-57UAdSwdjT8NmnB17RSAmyWhYYP9xi6DY6MJiQfnYYE8yQsHPHmXjXA0-_cXQjegxp7TvkS_cF0EFcuaqHtEBSrJnaG5QqVERaEsbacIG9Y9Toh_bJ8I9mpO2FQTzw7bCQyZYqOCF5_fTZ0vOM02Kt0ANwro9iNxogKViTgAbzYJyX3l9KHb11U-cKXGjUCMwEq8bq59YwP8CPrk2BG22XwXSNrtJg8Q%3D)**

_Just imagine if these comments were made by a conservative about a Black Democrat. They'd be fired immediately after going off air._

**I won't be quiet about this.** This columnist is saying horrible things about fellow human beings based on the color of their skin. That's simply wrong.

**[We hope you'll take a moment today to support our Senate campaign and show the people who want us to fail just how much support there is for Black conservatives in this country.](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=65f3efec361b4ea6b94e5a1125a40826&_e=Qiskcf3e0wlRem09PBEbbsnbUjJ3WOAsSkv71xM0vK3uEeAMOLPcRCqM5F0hneLm3A1XzYmHG1AukNelxclYYrrGzXoqhfQuGhQScL3G5hySdVzGSTXUs8gn0MVqWrO0P3_Q-zLy9CfMsRPa3XAAnQA9JQzDmSH3gFsFGvWZBiZrsq4OiTqfqJnD0cyLEcFQxlEUTHjPrerm7MnVvozWyx9SDn8zNUv7uwaNNKNIr5Xs0Euqzg7Ja7mn3-eSKP91uXCm67lr0O-57UAdSwdjTwkwapY615pP4pEEiC-ii2H48N0YX2IZTnQGkvD6c3RzNw1X-FNzWJDtePqnuvq1v4K1xgc50NYMZV28cBIkaNJlk16P1USAVp1JUZ8_m48z79yQOnsB0SKrGfBWGXDi0uYfTvFKxzf-QrIZhwRnPokiWBpcbA3hBQQid2Wiayk8jDUUb9YCMqN-ovkocydN3cm-lrGLNw867bIkPeMu-nk%3D)**
